It refers to medical providers with a contract with the insurer. The opposite, out-of-network, means little or no coverage, which is a clue in Part 7 questions.
words/#52-14/q/k: 보장을 전액 받으려면 웹사이트에 나온 '제휴' 의사에게 가야 하므로 in-network가 정답이다. in-depth(심층적인), in-flight(기내의), in-store(매장 내의)는 doctor를 수식하기에 의미가 맞지 않는다.

To get full coverage, members must see a "partnered" doctor listed on the website, so in-network is correct. In-depth (detailed), in-flight (on a plane), and in-store (inside a shop) don't make sense describing a doctor.
words/#52-15/exKo: 정규직 직원은 90일간의 수습 기간이 지나면 건강 보험 혜택을 받는다.
Full-time employees receive health insurance after a 90-day probation period.
words/#52-15/der/0/m: to get or provide coverage (against loss)
words/#52-15/tip: 불가산명사라 a health insurance로 쓰지 않으며, 복리후생(benefits)의 대표 항목으로 Part 7 채용 공고에 자주 나온다.
It is uncountable, so it is never a health insurance; as a key part of benefits, it often appears in Part 7 job postings.
words/#52-15/q/k: 치과 진료, 유급 휴가와 나란히 나열되는 복리후생 항목이므로 health insurance가 정답이다. health inspector(위생 검사관)는 혜택이 아니고 healthier는 형용사, healthily는 부사다.

It is a benefit listed alongside dental care and paid vacation, so health insurance is correct. Health inspector (official who checks hygiene) isn't a benefit, healthier is an adjective, and healthily is an adverb.
words/#52-16/exKo: 우리 회사의 모든 이삿짐 트럭은 손상과 도난에 대비한 보험에 완전히 가입되어 있다.
All of our moving trucks are fully insured against damage and theft.
words/#52-16/der/0/m: to get or provide coverage (against loss)
words/#52-16/tip: be insured against(~에 대비해 보험에 들어 있다)로 쓰며, the insured는 '피보험자'라는 명사로 쓰인다. 보험사는 insurer이다.
It is used as be insured against (be covered for), and the insured is a noun meaning "the person covered by a policy." The insurance company is the insurer.
words/#52-16/q/k: be동사 뒤에서 부사 fully의 수식을 받아 소포가 '보험에 가입된' 상태임을 나타내야 하므로 insured가 정답이다. insurance, insurer는 명사라 소포의 상태를 나타낼 수 없고 insuring은 능동의 의미라 맞지 않는다.

After the be verb and modified by the adverb fully, the blank must show that the package is "covered by insurance," so insured is correct. Insurance and insurer are nouns and can't describe the package's state, and insuring has an active meaning that doesn't fit.
words/#52-17/exKo: 우리 보험사는 손상된 창고의 수리비를 지급하기로 했다.
Our insurer has agreed to pay for the repairs to the damaged warehouse.
words/#52-17/der/0/m: to get or provide coverage (against loss)
words/#52-17/tip: 회사명사 insurer(보험사), insured(피보험자), insurance(보험)를 구분하는 품사 문제가 나온다.
Part-of-speech questions test the company noun insurer (insurance company), insured (person covered), and insurance (coverage).
words/#52-17/q/k: 치료비 보장을 '거절하며' 약관 조항을 근거로 드는 주체가 필요하므로 insurer(보험사)가 정답이다. insurance는 행위 주체가 될 수 없고, the insured(피보험자)는 보장을 해 주는 쪽이 아니며 insuring은 동명사다.

You need the party that "refuses" to cover the treatment, citing a policy exclusion, so insurer (insurance company) is correct. Insurance can't be the one acting, the insured (person covered) isn't the side providing coverage, and insuring is a gerund.
words/#52-18/m/0: person who holds an insurance policy; insured customer
words/#52-18/exKo: 모든 보험 계약자에게는 보장 내용에 관한 질문에 답해 줄 전담 설계사가 배정된다.
Every policyholder is assigned a personal agent who can answer questions about coverage.
words/#52-18/der/0/m: insurance contract; official plan or rule
words/#52-18/tip: policy(보험 증권) + holder(소지자)로 이루어진 단어로, Part 7 보험사 안내 편지의 수신인으로 자주 등장한다.
It is formed from policy (insurance contract) + holder (person who has it) and often appears as the recipient of Part 7 letters from insurance companies.
words/#52-18/q/k: 온라인으로 보험금을 청구하는 '사람'이 주어여야 하므로 policyholders가 정답이다. policies(보험 증권, 정책), polls(여론 조사), politics(정치)는 청구를 할 수 없다.
The subject must be "people" who file a claim online, so policyholders is correct. Policies (insurance contracts; rules), polls (surveys), and politics (government affairs) can't file a claim.
words/#52-19/exKo: 모든 신규 운전기사는 배송 업무를 시작하기 전에 신체검사를 통과해야 한다.
All new drivers must pass a physical before they begin making deliveries.
words/#52-19/der/0/m: in terms of the body; in a material way
words/#52-19/tip: 명사로 '건강 검진'(annual physical)을 뜻하고, 형용사로는 physical activity, physical copy(종이 사본)처럼 '신체의, 물리적인' 뜻으로 쓰인다. 의사 physician과 혼동하지 말 것.

As a noun it means "medical checkup" (annual physical); as an adjective it means "of the body; material," as in physical activity and physical copy (paper copy). Don't confuse it with physician (doctor).
words/#52-19/q/k: 관사 an과 형용사 annual 뒤 단수 명사 자리이며 회사가 비용을 대는 '연례 건강 검진'이므로 physical이 정답이다. physique(체격), physics(물리학)는 의미가 맞지 않고 physically는 부사다.

After the article an and the adjective annual, a singular noun is needed for the "annual checkup" the company pays for, so physical is correct. Physique (body shape) and physics (science of matter and energy) don't fit the meaning, and physically is an adverb.
words/#52-20/exKo: 그 회사는 직원들의 정신 건강을 지원하는 워크숍을 제공한다.
The company offers workshops to support employees' mental health.
words/#52-20/tip: mental health(정신 건강)가 대표 연어이며 Part 7에서 psychological, emotional로 바꿔 표현된다. 부사 mentally와의 품사 자리 구분도 출제된다.
Mental health (psychological well-being) is the key collocation, and in Part 7 it is paraphrased as psychological or emotional. Questions also test it vs. the adverb mentally.
words/#52-20/q/k: 소유격 employees'와 명사 focus 사이에서 명사를 수식하는 형용사가 필요하므로 mental이 정답이다. mentally는 부사, mentality와 mentor는 명사다.
Between the possessive employees' and the noun focus, an adjective modifying the noun is needed, so mental is correct. Mentally is an adverb, and mentality and mentor are nouns.
words/#52-21/exKo: 사고 후 Grant 씨는 일주일에 두 번 물리 치료를 받았다.
After the accident, Ms. Grant attended physical therapy twice a week.
words/#52-21/tip: physical therapy(물리 치료)처럼 주로 불가산으로 쓰며, 사람명사 therapist, 형용사 therapeutic과 구분해야 한다.
It is mostly uncountable, as in physical therapy (treatment through exercise); distinguish it from the person noun therapist and the adjective therapeutic.
words/#52-21/q/k: offers의 목적어로 '언어 치료'라는 불가산명사가 필요하므로 therapy가 정답이다. therapist는 가산명사라 관사 없이 단수로 쓸 수 없고, therapeutic은 형용사, therapeutically는 부사다.

The object of offers must be an uncountable noun meaning "speech treatment," so therapy is correct. Therapist is countable and can't be used in the singular without an article, therapeutic is an adjective, and therapeutically is an adverb.
words/#52-22/exKo: 자격증을 갖춘 마사지 치료사가 매일 호텔 스파에 상주한다.
A licensed massage therapist is available at the hotel spa every day.
words/#52-22/tip: 사람명사이므로 관사나 복수형과 함께 쓰인다. 치료 행위를 뜻하는 therapy와의 품사 구분이 출제된다.
It is a person noun, so it is used with an article or in the plural. Questions test its part of speech vs. therapy, which means treatment itself.
words/#52-22/q/k: worked as a(~로 일했다) 뒤에는 직업을 나타내는 사람명사가 와야 하므로 therapist가 정답이다. therapy, therapies는 치료 행위이고 therapeutic은 형용사다.
After worked as a (worked in the role of), you need a person noun for a job, so therapist is correct. Therapy and therapies refer to treatment, and therapeutic is an adjective.
words/#52-23/exKo: Sato 씨의 부러진 손목이 완전히 낫는 데 약 6주가 걸렸다.
It took about six weeks for Mr. Sato's broken wrist to heal completely.
words/#52-23/tip: 자동사(상처가 낫다)와 타동사(~을 치유하다)로 모두 쓰인다. 발음이 같은 heel(발뒤꿈치)과 혼동하게 하는 듣기 함정이 있다.
It is used both intransitively (a wound gets better) and transitively (to cure something). A listening trap confuses it with heel (back of the foot), which sounds the same.
words/#52-23/q/k: 주어 the injury가 목적어 없이 '다 나았다'는 뜻이어야 하므로 자동사로 쓰이는 heal의 과거분사 healed가 정답이다. cure, relieve, treat는 타동사라 목적어 없이 능동형으로 쓸 수 없고, cure는 상처보다 질병이나 환자를 목적어로 쓴다.

The subject the injury must "get better" without an object, so healed, the past participle of the intransitive heal, is correct. The verbs cure, relieve, and treat are transitive and can't be used in the active voice without an object, and cure usually takes an illness or a patient as its object, not an injury.
words/#52-24/exKo: 일부 국가로 가는 여행객은 특정 질병에 대한 예방 접종 증명을 제시해야 한다.
Travelers to some countries must show proof of immunization against certain diseases.
words/#52-24/tip: against와 함께 '~에 대한 예방 접종'을 뜻하며 Part 7에서 vaccination으로 바꿔 표현된다.
With against it means "vaccination against ~," and in Part 7 it is paraphrased as vaccination.
words/#52-24/q/k: record와 결합해 '예방 접종 기록'을 이루는 명사 immunization이 정답이다. immunize, immunized는 동사 형태이고 immune(면역성이 있는)은 record를 수식하기에 의미가 맞지 않는다.

The noun immunization combines with record to mean "vaccination record," so it is correct. Immunize and immunized are verb forms, and immune (protected from disease) doesn't make sense describing record.
words/#52-25/m/0: shot; injection that protects against disease
words/#52-25/exKo: 그 병원은 10월에 전 직원에게 독감 백신을 무료로 제공한다.
The clinic will offer free flu vaccines to all employees in October.
words/#52-25/tip: 가산명사로 the flu vaccine처럼 쓰며, 동사 vaccinate(접종하다)와 명사 vaccination(접종)을 구분하는 품사 문제가 나온다.
It is countable, as in the flu vaccine, and part-of-speech questions test it vs. the verb vaccinate (give a shot) and the noun vaccination (immunization).
words/#52-25/q/k: the seasonal flu 뒤 administer의 목적어가 되는 명사 자리이므로 vaccine이 정답이다. vaccinate, vaccinated, vaccinating은 동사 형태다.
After the seasonal flu, the blank is a noun acting as the object of administer, so vaccine is correct. The words vaccinate, vaccinated, and vaccinating are verb forms.
words/#52-26/exKo: 손을 자주 씻으면 감염 위험을 줄이는 데 도움이 된다.
Washing your hands often helps reduce the risk of infection.
words/#52-26/tip: risk of infection, prevent the spread of infection처럼 쓰이며 형용사 infectious(전염성의)와 품사를 구분한다.
It is used as in risk of infection and prevent the spread of infection; distinguish its part of speech from the adjective infectious (contagious).
words/#52-26/q/k: 전치사 of 뒤 명사 자리이므로 infection이 정답이다. infect는 동사, infectious와 infected는 형용사(분사)라 단독으로 명사 자리에 올 수 없다.
After the preposition of, the blank is a noun, so infection is correct. Infect is a verb, and infectious and infected are adjectives (participles) that can't stand alone in a noun slot.
words/#52-27/exKo: 열이 있는 직원은 몸이 나아질 때까지 집에 머물러야 한다.
Employees with a fever should stay home until they feel better.
words/#52-27/tip: have/run a fever(열이 나다)처럼 관사 a와 함께 쓰며, Part 3에서 결근·조퇴 이유로 자주 언급된다.
It is used with the article a, as in have/run a fever (have a high temperature), and in Part 3 it is often mentioned as a reason for being absent or leaving early.
words/#52-27/q/k: 심한 기침과 함께 조퇴 이유가 되는 '고열'이므로 fever가 정답이다. favor(호의), figure(수치), flavor(맛)는 형태가 비슷한 함정이다.
Together with a bad cough, a "high temperature" is the reason for leaving work early, so fever is correct. Favor (kindness), figure (number), and flavor (taste) are look-alike traps.
words/#52-28/exKo: 환자는 우리 웹사이트에서 집 근처의 의료 기관을 찾을 수 있다.
Patients can search for a health care provider near their home on our website.
words/#52-28/tip: health care provider(의료인, 의료 기관), internet service provider처럼 복합명사로 자주 쓰이며, 업체명사 provider와 동사 provide를 구분한다.
It is often used in compound nouns such as health care provider (doctor or medical facility) and internet service provider; distinguish the noun provider from the verb provide.
words/#52-28/q/k: 회사(Harmon Medical Supply)와 동격을 이루는 '공급 업체'가 필요하므로 provider가 정답이다. provision(공급, 조항)은 업체를 가리키지 못하고 provide, provided는 동사 형태다.
You need a "supplier" in apposition to the company Harmon Medical Supply, so provider is correct. Provision (supply; clause) can't refer to a company, and provide and provided are verb forms.
words/#52-29/exKo: Kowalski 씨는 어깨 수술 후 잘 회복하고 있다.
Mr. Kowalski is recovering well after surgery on his shoulder.
words/#52-29/tip: 주로 불가산으로 undergo/have surgery(수술을 받다)로 쓴다. 외과 의사 surgeon(Day 22), 형용사 surgical과 구분한다.
It is mostly uncountable and used as undergo/have surgery (have an operation). Distinguish it from surgeon (doctor who operates, Day 22) and the adjective surgical.
words/#52-29/q/k: undergo의 목적어로 '수술'이라는 명사가 필요하므로 surgery가 정답이다. surgeon(외과 의사)은 받는 대상이 아니고 surgical은 형용사, surgically는 부사다.
The object of undergo must be the noun for "operation," so surgery is correct. Surgeon (doctor who operates) isn't something you undergo, surgical is an adjective, and surgically is an adverb.
words/#52-30/exKo: 부상당한 작업자는 City 병원 응급실로 이송되었다.
The injured worker was taken to the emergency room at City Hospital.
words/#52-30/tip: ER로 줄여 쓰며, Part 7 보험 안내에서 응급실을 이용할 때 본인 부담금(co-pay)이 높다는 정보로 자주 나온다.
It is shortened to ER and often appears in Part 7 insurance notices with the information that using it involves a high co-pay.
words/#52-30/q/k: 가슴 통증이 있을 때 바로 가야 하는 곳은 응급실이므로 emergency room이 정답이다. emergency exit(비상구)는 대피할 때 쓰는 곳이고 conference room(회의실), storeroom(창고)도 문맥에 맞지 않는다.

Where you should go right away if you have chest pain is the ER, so emergency room is correct. Emergency exit (exit for evacuations) is used to escape a building, and conference room (meeting room) and storeroom (storage room) don't fit the context either.
words/#52-31/exKo: 직원들은 손님이 떠날 때마다 모든 테이블과 의자를 소독한다.
Staff sanitize all tables and chairs after each customer leaves.
words/#52-31/tip: hand sanitizer(손 소독제)가 빈출이며, sanitary(위생적인), sanitation(공중위생)과 품사를 구분해야 한다.
Hand sanitizer (hand disinfectant) is common, and you need to tell it apart from sanitary (hygienic) and sanitation (public hygiene).
words/#52-31/q/k: be required to 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 하므로 sanitize가 정답이다. sanitary는 형용사, sanitation과 sanitizer는 명사다.
The phrase be required to must be followed by a base verb, so sanitize is correct. Sanitary is an adjective, and sanitation and sanitizer are nouns.
words/#52-32/m/0: amount (of medicine) taken at one time
words/#52-32/exKo: The recommended dose for adults is two tablets every six hours.
words/#52-32/der/0/m: amount of medicine; directions for taking it
words/#52-32/tip: dose(1회 복용량)와 dosage(복용량, 투약법)는 Part 7 약품 설명서에서 바꿔 쓰인다. 발음이 비슷한 doze(졸다)와 혼동하지 말 것.
Dose (amount taken at one time) and dosage (amount; directions for taking medicine) are used interchangeably in Part 7 medicine instructions. Don't confuse it with doze (nap), which sounds similar.
words/#52-32/q/k: 약 라벨에 적힌 '1일 권장 복용량'을 넘기지 말라는 뜻이므로 dose가 정답이다. doze(선잠)는 발음이 비슷한 함정이고 deposit(보증금), digest(요약)는 의미가 맞지 않는다.

The point is not to exceed the "recommended daily amount" on the medication label, so dose is correct. Doze (light sleep) is a sound-alike trap, and deposit (down payment) and digest (summary) don't fit the meaning.
words/#52-33/exKo: 영양사가 구내식당 직원들이 더 건강한 점심 메뉴를 짜도록 도울 것이다.
A nutritionist will help the cafeteria staff plan healthier lunch menus.
words/#52-33/tip: nutrition(영양), nutritious(영양가 높은, Day 22), nutritional(영양의)과 사람명사 nutritionist를 구분하는 품사 문제가 나온다.
Part-of-speech questions test the person noun nutritionist vs. nutrition (nourishment), nutritious (healthy to eat, Day 22), and nutritional (relating to nourishment).
words/#52-33/q/k: hire의 목적어로 조언을 해 줄 '사람'이 필요하므로 nutritionist가 정답이다. nutrition은 영양이라는 개념이고 nutritious, nutritional은 형용사다.
The object of hire must be a "person" who gives advice, so nutritionist is correct. Nutrition is a concept, and nutritious and nutritional are adjectives.
words/#52-34/exKo: 그 프로그램의 모든 수료생은 무료 진로 상담을 받을 수 있다.
Free career counseling is available to all graduates of the program.
words/#52-34/tip: 불가산명사라 a counseling으로 쓰지 않으며, 사람명사 counselor(상담사)와 구분한다. 영국식 철자는 counselling이다.
It is uncountable, so it is never a counseling; distinguish it from the person noun counselor (adviser). The British spelling is counselling.
words/#52-34/q/k: provides의 목적어로 관사 없이 쓸 수 있는 불가산명사가 필요하므로 counseling이 정답이다. counselor는 가산명사라 관사 없이 단수로 쓸 수 없고, counsels, counseled는 동사 형태다.

The object of provides must be an uncountable noun usable without an article, so counseling is correct. Counselor is countable and can't be used in the singular without an article, and counsels and counseled are verb forms.
words/#52-35/exKo: 그 약국은 정문 근처에서 다양한 비타민 보충제를 판매한다.
The pharmacy sells a wide range of vitamin supplements near the front entrance.
words/#52-35/tip: 명사(보충제, 부록)와 동사(보충하다)로 모두 쓰이며 supplement A with B(A를 B로 보충하다)가 출제된다. 형용사 supplementary도 함께 알아 두자.
It is used both as a noun (nutrient pill; extra section) and a verb (to add to), and supplement A with B (add B to A) is tested. Also learn the adjective supplementary.
words/#52-35/q/k: 주어 Many employees 뒤 동사 자리이므로 동사로도 쓰이는 supplement(보충하다)가 정답이다. supplementary, supplemental은 형용사, supplementation은 명사다.
After the subject Many employees, the blank is the verb, so supplement (add to), which can also be a verb, is correct. Supplementary and supplemental are adjectives, and supplementation is a noun.
words/#52-36/exKo: 처방전 없이 살 수 있는 진통제는 호텔 기념품점에서 구할 수 있다.
Over-the-counter pain relievers are available at the hotel gift shop.
words/#52-36/tip: 처방전(prescription) 없이 살 수 있는 약을 뜻하며 OTC로 줄여 쓰고 Part 7에서 nonprescription으로 바꿔 표현된다.
It refers to medicine you can buy without a prescription, is shortened to OTC, and in Part 7 is paraphrased as nonprescription.
words/#52-36/q/k: 감기나 두통 같은 가벼운 증상에 약사가 권하는 약은 '처방전 없이 살 수 있는' 약이므로 over-the-counter가 정답이다. out-of-town(타지의), behind-the-scenes(막후의), round-the-clock(24시간 내내의)은 medicine을 수식하기에 어색하다.

Medicine a pharmacist recommends for minor problems such as colds and headaches is "nonprescription" medicine, so over-the-counter is correct. Out-of-town (from elsewhere), behind-the-scenes (hidden from the public), and round-the-clock (24-hour) sound odd describing medicine.
words/#52-37/exKo: Han 씨는 집에 가는 길에 기침 사탕을 사려고 약국에 들렀다.
Ms. Han stopped at a drugstore on her way home to buy cough drops.
words/#52-37/tip: 약 외에 화장품·생활용품도 파는 가게로, Part 3·4에서 pharmacy와 같은 장소를 가리키는 말로 쓰인다.
It is a store that sells cosmetics and household goods as well as medicine, and in Part 3·4 it refers to the same place as pharmacy.
words/#52-37/q/k: 감기약과 샴푸를 살 수 있는 곳은 약국이므로 drugstore가 정답이다. laundromat(빨래방), car wash(세차장), post office(우체국)에서는 약을 팔지 않는다.
The place where you can buy cold medicine and shampoo is a pharmacy, so drugstore is correct. Laundromat (self-service laundry), car wash, and post office don't sell medicine.
words/#52-38/m/1: relating to pharmacy (the study of drugs)
words/#52-38/exKo: 그 제약 회사는 계절성 알레르기 신약을 시험하고 있다.
The pharmaceutical company is testing a new drug for seasonal allergies.
words/#52-38/der/0/m: store selling medicine; study of drugs
words/#52-38/der/1/m: person who prepares and sells medicine
words/#52-38/tip: 형용사로 pharmaceutical company/industry처럼 쓰이며, 복수형 pharmaceuticals는 '의약품'이라는 명사다.
As an adjective it is used as in pharmaceutical company/industry, and the plural pharmaceuticals is a noun meaning "medicines".
words/#52-38/q/k: 명사 research를 수식해 '제약 연구'라는 뜻을 만드는 형용사 pharmaceutical이 정답이다. pharmacist(약사), pharmacies(약국)는 research와 결합해 연구 분야를 나타내지 못하고 pharmaceutically는 부사다.

The adjective pharmaceutical modifies the noun research to mean "drug research," so it is correct. Pharmacist (person who prepares medicine) and pharmacies (drugstores) can't combine with research to name a field, and pharmaceutically is an adverb.
words/#52-39/exKo: 그 병원은 만성 요통 환자 치료를 전문으로 한다.
The clinic specializes in treating patients with chronic back pain.
words/#52-39/tip: 질병뿐 아니라 chronic shortage of staff(만성적인 인력 부족)처럼 비즈니스 문맥에도 쓰인다. 반의어는 acute(급성의)이다.
It is used not only for illnesses but also in business contexts, as in chronic shortage of staff (ongoing staff shortage). The opposite is acute (sudden and severe).
words/#52-39/q/k: 2년 동안 이어진 '만성적인' 인력 부족을 뜻하므로 형용사 chronic이 정답이다. chronological(연대순의)은 의미가 맞지 않고, chronicle은 명사·동사, chronically는 부사다.

It means an "ongoing" staff shortage lasting two years, so the adjective chronic is correct. Chronological (in time order) doesn't fit the meaning, chronicle is a noun/verb, and chronically is an adverb.
words/#52-40/exKo: 장거리 비행은 피로를 유발할 수 있어 일정에 휴식일이 포함되어 있다.
Long flights can cause fatigue, so the itinerary includes a rest day.
words/#52-40/tip: 불가산명사로 Part 7 약품 설명서의 부작용(side effect) 목록에 자주 나오며 tiredness, exhaustion으로 바꿔 표현된다.
An uncountable noun that often appears in lists of side effects in Part 7 medicine instructions; it is paraphrased as tiredness or exhaustion.
words/#52-40/q/k: 두통과 함께 약의 부작용으로 나열되는 것은 '피로'이므로 fatigue가 정답이다. fatality(사망자), facility(시설), feature(특징)는 부작용이 될 수 없다.

Listed alongside headaches as a side effect of the medication is "tiredness," so fatigue is correct. Fatality (death), facility (building; equipment), and feature (characteristic) can't be side effects.
words/#53-01/exKo: 우리 회사의 새 포장재는 환경에 미치는 피해를 줄이도록 설계되었다.
Our new packaging is designed to reduce harm to the environment.
words/#53-01/der/1/m: in terms of nature or surroundings
words/#53-01/tip: '자연환경' 외에 work environment(업무 환경)처럼 '환경, 여건'의 뜻이 자주 나오며, 형용사 environmental과 품사를 구분한다.
Besides "the natural world," it often means "setting; conditions," as in work environment (workplace setting); distinguish its part of speech from the adjective environmental.
words/#53-01/q/k: 형용사 positive와 명사 work 뒤에 와서 '업무 환경'을 이루는 명사 environment가 정답이다. environmental은 형용사, environmentally는 부사이고 environmentalist(환경 운동가)는 의미가 맞지 않는다.

After the adjective positive and the noun work, the noun environment forms "work setting," so it is correct. Environmental is an adjective, environmentally is an adverb, and environmentalist (activist for nature) doesn't fit the meaning.
words/#53-02/m/1: relating to nature and the surroundings
words/#53-02/exKo: 주민들은 화학 공장 건설 계획을 두고 환경 측면의 우려를 제기했다.
Residents raised environmental concerns about the proposed chemical plant.
words/#53-02/der/1/m: in terms of nature or surroundings
words/#53-02/tip: 명사 앞 형용사 자리 문제로 자주 나오며, environmentally friendly(Day 23)처럼 형용사 앞에는 부사 environmentally를 쓴다.
It often appears in questions on adjective slots before nouns; before an adjective, use the adverb environmentally, as in environmentally friendly (Day 23).
words/#53-02/q/k: 명사 standards를 수식하는 형용사 자리이므로 environmental이 정답이다. environmentally는 부사라 명사를 수식할 수 없고, environmentalist(환경 운동가)와 environmentalism(환경 보호주의)은 의미가 맞지 않는다.

The blank is an adjective modifying the noun standards, so environmental is correct. Environmentally is an adverb and can't modify a noun, and environmentalist (activist for nature) and environmentalism (movement to protect nature) don't fit the meaning.
words/#53-03/exKo: 야외 콘서트는 거센 폭우 때문에 연기되었다.
The outdoor concert was postponed because of a heavy downpour.
words/#53-03/der/0/m: (of rain) to fall heavily; to fill (a cup) with liquid
words/#53-03/tip: Part 4 일기 예보에서 heavy rain, rainstorm으로 바꿔 표현되며, '비가 억수로 쏟아지다'는 동사 pour로 말한다.
In Part 4 weather forecasts it is paraphrased as heavy rain or rainstorm, and "to rain very heavily" is expressed with the verb pour.
words/#53-03/q/k: 통근자들의 지연을 일으키는 '갑작스러운 폭우'이므로 downpour가 정답이다. downsizing(감원), download(다운로드), downtown(시내)은 a sudden과 어울려 교통 지연의 원인이 될 수 없다.

It is a "sudden heavy rain" that causes delays for commuters, so downpour is correct. Downsizing (job cuts), download (transferring a file), and downtown (city center) can't combine with a sudden as a cause of traffic delays.
words/#53-04/exKo: 토요일 오전 9시부터 11시까지 건물의 전기 공급이 중단된다.
Power in the building will be shut off from 9 to 11 A.M. on Saturday.
words/#53-04/tip: power outage/failure(정전)가 Part 4 공지에 자주 나오며, 동사로 '동력을 공급하다'(be powered by)로도 쓰인다.
Power outage/failure (blackout) often appears in Part 4 notices, and it is also a verb meaning "to supply energy to" (be powered by).
words/#53-04/q/k: be동사 뒤에서 by electricity와 함께 '전기로 움직인다'는 수동의 의미가 되어야 하므로 power의 과거분사 powered가 정답이다. powerful은 형용사라 by와 어울리지 않고 powerfully는 부사, power는 원형이다.

After the be verb, with by electricity it needs the passive meaning "run on electricity," so powered, the past participle of power, is correct. Powerful is an adjective and doesn't go with by, powerfully is an adverb, and power is the base form.
words/#53-05/exKo: 새 댐은 강의 에너지를 활용해 그 지역에 전기를 공급할 것이다.
The new dam will harness the river's energy to supply electricity to the region.
words/#53-05/tip: 원래 '(말에) 마구를 채우다'라는 뜻에서 '(자연력·자원을) 동력으로 이용하다'의 뜻으로 쓰이며 Part 7에서 utilize, make use of로 바꿔 표현된다. 명사로는 '안전벨트 장치'를 뜻한다.

From its original meaning "to put equipment on (a horse)," it came to mean "to use (natural forces or resources) as power," and in Part 7 it is paraphrased as utilize or make use of. As a noun it means "safety straps".
words/#53-05/q/k: 풍력 에너지를 더 효율적으로 '활용하는' 기술이므로 harness가 정답이다. harass(괴롭히다), hinder(방해하다), hesitate(망설이다)는 의미가 맞지 않는다.
It is technology to "make use of" wind energy more efficiently, so harness is correct. Harass (bother), hinder (get in the way of), and hesitate (pause before acting) don't fit the meaning.
words/#53-06/exKo: 한 작업자가 계단을 따라 새 난간을 설치하고 있다.
A worker is installing a new handrail along the staircase.
words/#53-06/tip: Part 1 사진 묘사 빈출어로 'A woman is holding onto a handrail.'처럼 나오며 railing과 바꿔 쓸 수 있다.
It is a frequent word in Part 1 photo descriptions, as in "A woman is holding onto a handrail," and can be used interchangeably with railing.
words/#53-06/q/k: 정문 경사로를 따라 설치되는 것은 '난간'이므로 handrail이 정답이다. handout(유인물), handbook(안내서), handshake(악수)는 경사로에 설치할 수 있는 것이 아니다.

What is installed along the ramp at the main entrance is a "railing," so handrail is correct. Handout (printed sheet), handbook (guidebook), and handshake (greeting with hands) can't be installed along a ramp.
words/#53-07/exKo: 지붕 작업을 시작하기 전에 위험성 평가를 반드시 마쳐야 한다.
A risk assessment must be completed before any work begins on the roof.
words/#53-07/tip: conduct/carry out a risk assessment 형태로 Part 7 안전 공지·보고서에 나오며 safety evaluation으로 바꿔 표현된다.
It appears in Part 7 safety notices and reports as conduct/carry out a risk assessment and is paraphrased as safety evaluation.
words/#53-07/q/k: 창고의 잠재적 위험을 찾기 위해 실시하는 것은 '위험성 평가'이므로 risk assessment가 정답이다. market share(시장 점유율), price estimate(가격 견적), sales forecast(매출 예측)는 위험 파악과 관련이 없다.

What the inspector carries out to find potential dangers in the warehouse is a "safety evaluation," so risk assessment is correct. Market share (portion of sales), price estimate (quote), and sales forecast (sales prediction) have nothing to do with identifying dangers.
words/#53-08/m/0: garbage collection and disposal; handling of trash
words/#53-08/exKo: 시는 폐기물 관리를 담당할 민간 업체를 고용했다.
The city has hired a private company to handle waste management.
words/#53-08/tip: 폐기물의 수거·처리·재활용 전 과정을 가리키며, Part 7에서 garbage collection, disposal 같은 표현으로 바꿔 나온다.
It covers the whole process of collecting, treating, and recycling trash, and in Part 7 it is paraphrased with expressions like garbage collection and disposal.
words/#53-08/q/k: 재활용과 쓰레기 수거를 포함하는 서비스는 '폐기물 관리'이므로 waste management가 정답이다. time management(시간 관리), management consulting(경영 컨설팅), property management(부동산 관리)는 재활용·수거와 관련이 없다.

Services that include recycling and garbage collection are "trash handling" services, so waste management is correct. Time management (organizing your time), management consulting (business advice), and property management (managing buildings) have nothing to do with recycling or collection.
words/#53-09/m/0: rainfall; amount of rain or snow
words/#53-09/exKo: 기상 예보관들은 이번 주말 북부 지역에 많은 비나 눈이 내릴 것으로 예상한다.
Forecasters expect heavy precipitation in the northern region this weekend.
words/#53-09/tip: 비·눈·우박을 모두 포함하는 불가산명사로 Part 4 일기 예보에서 rain, snow로 바꿔 표현된다.
An uncountable noun covering rain, snow, and hail; in Part 4 weather forecasts it is paraphrased as rain or snow.
words/#53-09/q/k: 피크닉을 실내로 옮길 수 있다는 내용으로 보아 '강수' 확률을 말하므로 precipitation이 정답이다. participation(참가), preparation(준비), prescription(처방)은 형태가 비슷한 함정이다.

Since the picnic may be moved indoors, it refers to the chance of "rain," so precipitation is correct. Participation (taking part), preparation (getting ready), and prescription (doctor's order for medicine) are look-alike traps.
words/#53-10/exKo: 하루 종일 하늘이 흐리고 저녁에는 약한 비가 내리겠다.
Skies will remain overcast throughout the day, with light rain in the evening.
words/#53-10/tip: Part 4 일기 예보에서 cloudy와 같은 뜻으로 쓰이며, sunny와 대비되는 정보로 일정 변경 이유를 묻는 문제에 나온다.
In Part 4 weather forecasts it means the same as cloudy, and as information contrasting with sunny it appears in questions asking why a schedule changed.
words/#53-10/q/k: 오후에 해가 나온다는 내용과 Although로 대조되므로 아침 날씨가 '흐릴' 것이라는 overcast가 정답이다. overdue(기한이 지난), overbooked(초과 예약된), overhead(머리 위의)는 날씨를 나타내지 못한다.

Although contrasts it with the sun coming out in the afternoon, so overcast, meaning the morning will be "cloudy," is correct. Overdue (late), overbooked (booked beyond capacity), and overhead (above your head) can't describe the weather.
words/#53-11/exKo: 오늘 아침 도로가 얼어 있어 운전자들은 속도를 줄이도록 권고된다.
Drivers are advised to slow down because the roads are icy this morning.
words/#53-11/tip: Part 4 교통 방송에서 icy roads(빙판길)가 지연·사고 원인으로 나오며 slippery로 바꿔 표현된다.
In Part 4 traffic reports, icy roads (frozen, slippery roads) appear as a cause of delays and accidents, and it is paraphrased as slippery.
words/#53-11/q/k: 항공편 지연의 원인이 되는 활주로의 '결빙' 상태이므로 icy가 정답이다. idle(놀고 있는), ideal(이상적인), identical(동일한)은 지연의 원인이 될 수 없다.
It is the "frozen" condition of the runways that causes flight delays, so icy is correct. Idle (not in use), ideal (perfect), and identical (exactly the same) can't cause delays.
words/#53-12/m/0: fire risk (something that could start a fire)
words/#53-12/exKo: 노후한 사무실 건물에서 가장 흔한 화재 위험 요소는 결함이 있는 배선이다.
Faulty wiring is the most common fire hazard in older office buildings.
words/#53-12/tip: pose/create a fire hazard 형태로 쓰이며, Part 7 안전 공지에서 통로에 물건을 두지 말라는 근거로 자주 나온다.
It is used as pose/create a fire hazard, and in Part 7 safety notices it is often given as the reason not to leave things in hallways.
words/#53-12/q/k: 과부하된 멀티탭이 일으킬 수 있는 것은 '화재 위험'이므로 fire hazard가 정답이다. fire drill(소방 훈련), fire department(소방서), fireplace(벽난로)는 문맥에 맞지 않는다.

What overloaded power strips can create is a "fire risk," so fire hazard is correct. Fire drill (practice evacuation), fire department (firefighters' service), and fireplace (place for a fire in a room) don't fit the context.
words/#53-13/exKo: 모든 방문객은 자신의 안전을 위해 안전모를 착용해야 한다.
All visitors must wear hard hats for their own safety.
words/#53-13/tip: 명사 safety와 형용사 safe, 부사 safely를 구분하는 품사 문제가 자주 나오며 safety regulations처럼 복합명사로 쓰인다.
Part-of-speech questions often test the noun safety vs. the adjective safe and the adverb safely, and it is used in compound nouns like safety regulations.
words/#53-13/q/k: workplace와 함께 improve의 목적어가 되어 '작업장 안전'을 이루는 명사 자리이므로 safety가 정답이다. safe와 safer는 형용사, safely는 부사라 목적어 자리에 올 수 없다.

With workplace, the blank is a noun acting as the object of improve and meaning "protection of workers," so safety is correct. Safe and safer are adjectives, and safely is an adverb, so none can be the object.
words/#53-14/m/0: catastrophe caused by nature (earthquake, flood, etc.)
words/#53-14/exKo: 새 병원은 지진과 기타 자연재해를 견딜 수 있도록 설계되었다.
The new hospital is designed to withstand earthquakes and other natural disasters.
words/#53-14/col/0/k: in the event of a natural disaster
words/#53-14/tip: 지진·홍수·태풍 등을 포괄하는 말로 Part 7 보험 안내와 재난 대비 공지에서 자주 쓰인다.
It covers earthquakes, floods, typhoons, and so on, and is often used in Part 7 insurance notices and disaster-preparedness notices.
words/#53-14/q/k: 지진 같은 비상 상황에 대비한 계획이므로 '자연재해'를 뜻하는 natural disaster가 정답이다. natural resource(천연자원), natural light(자연광), natural ingredient(천연 재료)는 지진의 상위 개념이 아니다.

It is a plan for emergencies such as an earthquake, so natural disaster, meaning "catastrophe caused by nature," is correct. Natural resource (raw material from nature), natural light (sunlight), and natural ingredient (non-artificial component) aren't categories that include earthquakes.
words/#53-15/exKo: 건물을 빠져나온 직원들은 주차장에 있는 집결지로 가야 한다.
After leaving the building, staff should go to the assembly point in the parking lot.
words/#53-15/tip: Part 4 대피 훈련(fire drill) 안내에서 대피 후 모이는 장소로 나오며 meeting point로 바꿔 표현된다.
In Part 4 fire drill announcements it is the place to gather after evacuating, and it is paraphrased as meeting point.
words/#53-15/q/k: 대피 훈련 중 길 건너편의 지정된 장소로 모여야 하므로 '집결지'를 뜻하는 assembly point가 정답이다. assembly line(조립 라인), point of view(관점), turning point(전환점)는 대피 장소가 아니다.

During the drill, employees must gather at a designated place across the street, so assembly point, meaning "meeting point," is correct. Assembly line (production line), point of view (opinion), and turning point (moment of change) aren't evacuation spots.
words/#53-16/exKo: 새로운 시장에 투자하는 데는 항상 어느 정도의 위험이 따른다.
Investing in a new market always involves some risk.
words/#53-16/tip: at risk of(~의 위험이 있는), reduce the risk of처럼 전치사 of와 함께 자주 쓰이며 형용사 risky와 품사를 구분한다.
It is often used with the preposition of, as in at risk of (in danger of) and reduce the risk of, and its part of speech is tested vs. the adjective risky.
words/#53-16/q/k: be at risk of(~의 위험이 있다)는 전치사 at 뒤에 명사가 오는 고정 표현이므로 risk가 정답이다. risky, riskier는 형용사, risked는 동사의 과거형이다.
Be at risk of (be in danger of) is a fixed expression with a noun after the preposition at, so risk is correct. Risky and riskier are adjectives, and risked is the past tense of the verb.
words/#53-17/exKo: An electrical problem caused the lights on the third floor to go out.
words/#53-17/der/1/m: person who installs and repairs wiring
words/#53-17/tip: electrical은 electrical wiring처럼 '전기와 관련된', electric은 electric car처럼 '전기로 움직이는'의 뜻으로 주로 쓴다. 사람명사 electrician도 함께 출제된다.
Electrical usually means "relating to electricity," as in electrical wiring, while electric usually means "powered by electricity," as in electric car. The person noun electrician is also tested.
words/#53-17/q/k: 명사 outlets를 수식해 '전기 콘센트'를 이루는 형용사 자리이므로 electrical이 정답이다. electricity(전기), electrician(전기 기사)은 명사, electrically는 부사다.

The blank is an adjective modifying the noun outlets to mean "power sockets," so electrical is correct. Electricity (electric power) and electrician (wiring technician) are nouns, and electrically is an adverb.
words/#53-18/exKo: 작업자들은 기계를 작동할 때 귀 보호 장비를 착용해야 한다.
Workers must wear ear protection when operating the machines.
words/#53-18/tip: protection against/from(~로부터의 보호)의 전치사가 짝으로 출제되며, 형용사 protective(protective gear 보호 장비)와 구분한다.
The prepositions in protection against/from (defense against) are tested together, and it is distinguished from the adjective protective (protective gear = safety equipment).
words/#53-18/q/k: 형용사 excellent의 수식을 받으며 provides의 목적어가 되는 명사 자리이므로 protection이 정답이다. protective, protected는 형용사(분사), protect는 동사다.
Modified by the adjective excellent and acting as the object of provides, the blank is a noun, so protection is correct. Protective and protected are adjectives (participles), and protect is a verb.
words/#53-19/m/1: to avoid; to keep from happening
words/#53-19/exKo: 정기 점검은 창고 내 사고를 예방하는 데 도움이 된다.
Regular inspections help prevent accidents in the warehouse.
words/#53-19/tip: prevent A from -ing(A가 ~하는 것을 막다) 구문이 자주 출제되며 명사 prevention, 형용사 preventive와 품사를 구분한다.
The pattern prevent A from -ing (stop A from doing) is often tested, and its part of speech is tested vs. the noun prevention and the adjective preventive.
words/#53-19/q/k: 'A가 ~하는 것을 막다'라는 뜻의 prevent A from -ing 구문이므로 prevent가 정답이다. protect A from은 위험'으로부터' 보호한다는 뜻이라 동명사 entering과 맞지 않고, avoid는 이 구문을 취하지 않으며 refrain은 자동사다.

It is the pattern prevent A from -ing (stop A from doing), so prevent is correct. The pattern protect A from means protecting "from" danger and doesn't fit with the gerund entering, avoid doesn't take this pattern, and refrain is intransitive.
words/#53-20/exKo: 가연성 물질은 열원에서 멀리 떨어진 곳에 보관해야 한다.
Flammable materials must be stored away from heat sources.
words/#53-20/tip: flammable과 inflammable은 둘 다 '불에 잘 타는'이라는 같은 뜻이며, 반의어는 nonflammable이다. inflammable의 in-을 부정 접두사로 착각하지 않도록 주의한다.
Flammable and inflammable both mean "burning easily," and the opposite is nonflammable. Don't mistake the in- of inflammable for a negative prefix.
words/#53-20/q/k: 불꽃 가까이에서 쓰면 안 되는 이유는 '불에 잘 타기' 때문이므로 flammable이 정답이다. fashionable(유행하는), affordable(저렴한), adjustable(조절 가능한)은 문맥에 맞지 않는다.

The reason it must never be used near an open flame is that it "burns easily," so flammable is correct. Fashionable (stylish), affordable (inexpensive), and adjustable (can be changed) don't fit the context.
words/#53-21/exKo: 토양 침식을 줄이기 위해 강을 따라 나무를 심었다.
Trees were planted along the river to reduce soil erosion.
words/#53-21/tip: 비유적으로 erosion of profits/trust(이익·신뢰의 감소)처럼 비즈니스 문맥에도 쓰이며 동사 erode와 품사를 구분한다.
It is also used figuratively in business contexts, as in erosion of profits/trust (gradual loss of profits or trust), and its part of speech is tested vs. the verb erode.
words/#53-21/q/k: 형용사 Coastal의 수식을 받는 주어 자리이므로 명사 erosion이 정답이다. erode, eroded는 동사 형태이고 erosive는 형용사다.
It is the subject modified by the adjective Coastal, so the noun erosion is correct. Erode and eroded are verb forms, and erosive is an adjective.
words/#53-22/exKo: 기상학자는 주말 내내 하늘이 맑을 것이라고 예보했다.
The meteorologist predicted clear skies for the entire weekend.
words/#53-22/tip: Part 4 일기 예보의 화자로 자주 등장하며 weather forecaster로 바꿔 표현된다. meteor(유성)와는 뜻이 관련 없다.
It often appears as the speaker in Part 4 weather forecasts and is paraphrased as weather forecaster. It has nothing to do with meteor (shooting star) in meaning.
words/#53-22/q/k: 소유격과 chief 뒤에 와서 날씨를 예보하는 '사람'이 필요하므로 meteorologist가 정답이다. meteorology(기상학)는 학문이고 meteorological은 형용사, meteorologically는 부사다.

After the possessive and chief, a "person" who forecasts the weather is needed, so meteorologist is correct. Meteorology (study of weather) is a field, meteorological is an adjective, and meteorologically is an adverb.
words/#53-23/m/0: amount of moisture in the air
words/#53-23/exKo: 높은 습도는 보관 중인 종이 문서를 손상시킬 수 있다.
High humidity can damage paper documents in storage.
words/#53-23/der/1/m: machine that adds moisture to the air
words/#53-23/tip: 형용사 humid(습한)와 명사 humidity를 구분하는 품사 문제가 나오며, Part 4 일기 예보에서 heat and humidity로 함께 쓰인다.
Part-of-speech questions test the adjective humid (damp) vs. the noun humidity, and in Part 4 weather forecasts they appear together as heat and humidity.
words/#53-23/q/k: and로 the temperature와 대등하게 연결되는 명사가 필요하므로 humidity가 정답이다. humid는 형용사, humidify는 동사, humidly는 부사다.
A noun parallel to the temperature, joined by and, is needed, so humidity is correct. Humid is an adjective, humidify is a verb, and humidly is an adverb.
words/#53-24/exKo: 지난주 홍수로 시내 상점 여러 곳이 피해를 입었다.
Last week's flood damaged several shops in the downtown area.
words/#53-24/tip: 동사로 be flooded with calls/orders(전화·주문이 쇄도하다)라는 비유적 의미가 Part 7에 자주 나온다.
As a verb, its figurative meaning be flooded with calls/orders (receive a huge number of calls or orders) often appears in Part 7.
words/#53-24/q/k: be flooded with(~이 쇄도하다)라는 표현이므로 flooded가 정답이다. floated(떠 있던), flowed(흘렀다), flown(fly의 과거분사)은 with calls와 결합해 쇄도의 의미를 만들지 못한다.

It is the expression be flooded with (receive a huge number of), so flooded is correct. Floated (stayed on the surface), flowed (moved like liquid), and flown (past participle of fly) can't combine with with calls to mean a rush of calls.
words/#53-25/exKo: 작업자들은 식품 오염을 막기 위해 장갑을 착용한다.
Workers wear gloves to avoid contamination of the food products.
words/#53-25/tip: 동사 contaminate(Day 23)와 품사를 구분하며, Part 7 제품 회수(recall) 공지에서 회수 이유로 자주 나온다.
Distinguish its part of speech from the verb contaminate (Day 23); it often appears in Part 7 recall notices as the reason for a recall.
words/#53-25/q/k: revealed의 목적어가 되는 명사 자리이므로 contamination이 정답이다. contaminate, contaminates는 동사, contaminated는 과거분사라 목적어 자리에 올 수 없다.
The blank is a noun acting as the object of revealed, so contamination is correct. Contaminate and contaminates are verbs, and contaminated is a past participle, so none can be the object.
words/#53-26/exKo: 오염 물질을 많이 배출하는 차량은 내년부터 도심 진입이 금지된다.
Cars that emit high levels of pollution will be banned from the city center next year.
words/#53-26/tip: 명사 emission(Day 23)과 품사를 구분하며 Part 7에서 release, give off로 바꿔 표현된다. 과거형은 t를 겹쳐 emitted로 쓴다.
Distinguish its part of speech from the noun emission (Day 23); in Part 7 it is paraphrased as release or give off. The past tense doubles the t: emitted.
words/#53-26/q/k: 보일러가 연기를 '내뿜는다'는 뜻이므로 emit이 정답이다. omit(생략하다), admit(인정하다), submit(제출하다)은 smoke를 목적어로 쓰기에 의미가 맞지 않는다.
The boilers "give off" smoke, so emit is correct. Omit (leave out), admit (confess; let in), and submit (hand in) don't make sense with smoke as the object.
words/#53-27/exKo: 그 호텔은 작년에 친환경 세제로 바꿨다.
The hotel switched to eco-friendly cleaning products last year.
words/#53-27/tip: environmentally friendly(Day 23), green과 같은 뜻으로 Part 7에서 서로 바꿔 표현된다.
It means the same as environmentally friendly (Day 23) and green, and they are used interchangeably in Part 7.
words/#53-27/q/k: 태양광 패널과 빗물 수집 시설을 갖춘 건물을 설명하므로 '친환경적인'이라는 eco-friendly가 정답이다. family-run(가족이 운영하는), short-term(단기의), last-minute(막바지의)은 건물의 특징을 나타내지 못한다.

It describes a building with solar panels and a rainwater collection system, so eco-friendly, meaning "good for the environment," is correct. Family-run (managed by a family), short-term (temporary), and last-minute (at the latest moment) can't describe the building's features.
words/#53-28/exKo: 수건을 재사용하는 투숙객은 호텔이 물을 절약하는 데 도움을 준다.
Guests who reuse their towels help the hotel save water.
words/#53-28/tip: 형용사 reusable(Day 23)과 품사를 구분하며 reduce, reuse, recycle이 함께 나온다. 명사로도 쓰이는데 이때는 발음이 [riːjúːs]로 달라진다.
Distinguish its part of speech from the adjective reusable (Day 23); it appears together with reduce, reuse, recycle. It is also a noun, and then the pronunciation changes to [riːjúːs].
words/#53-28/q/k: be encouraged to 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 하므로 reuse가 정답이다. reusable은 형용사이고 reused, reusing은 to 뒤에 올 수 없다.
The phrase be encouraged to must be followed by a base verb, so reuse is correct. Reusable is an adjective, and reused and reusing can't follow to.
words/#53-29/m/0: using heat from inside the earth
words/#53-29/exKo: 그 사무실 건물은 지하에 설치된 지열 시스템으로 난방된다.
The office building is heated by a geothermal system installed underground.
words/#53-29/tip: geo(땅) + thermal(열)로 이루어진 단어로, Part 7 재생 에너지 관련 기사에서 solar, wind와 함께 나온다.
It is made of geo (earth) + thermal (heat) and appears with solar and wind in Part 7 articles on renewable energy.
words/#53-29/q/k: 땅속 깊은 곳의 열을 이용하는 시설이므로 '지열의'라는 geothermal이 정답이다. geometric(기하학적인), geological(지질학의), geographic(지리적인)은 열을 이용한 발전 시설을 나타내지 못한다.

The facilities use heat from deep underground, so geothermal, meaning "using heat from inside the earth," is correct. Geometric (relating to shapes), geological (relating to rocks and the earth's structure), and geographic (relating to places and regions) can't describe power plants that use heat.
words/#53-30/exKo: 그 수력 발전 댐은 백만 가구 이상에 전력을 공급한다.
The hydroelectric dam supplies power to over a million homes.
words/#53-30/tip: hydro(물) + electric(전기)으로 이루어진 단어로, renewable energy(Day 23)의 한 종류로 Part 7 기사에 나온다.
It is made of hydro (water) + electric (electricity) and appears in Part 7 articles as one type of renewable energy (Day 23).
words/#53-30/q/k: 강의 빠른 물살을 이용해 만드는 전력이므로 '수력 발전의'라는 hydroelectric이 정답이다. hypothetical(가설의), hydrated(수분을 공급받은), hygienic(위생적인)은 power를 수식하기에 의미가 맞지 않는다.

The power is generated from the river's strong current, so hydroelectric, meaning "generated from water power," is correct. Hypothetical (imagined), hydrated (supplied with water), and hygienic (clean) don't make sense describing power.
words/#53-31/m/0: trash left on the ground; rubbish
words/#53-31/exKo: 자원봉사자들은 토요일 아침 해변을 따라 쓰레기를 주웠다.
Volunteers picked up litter along the beach on Saturday morning.
words/#53-31/tip: 명사(길에 버려진 쓰레기)와 동사(쓰레기를 버리다)로 쓰이며, 'No littering' 표지와 쓰레기 투기 벌금 안내가 Part 7에 나온다.
It is used both as a noun (trash left on the ground) and a verb (to drop trash), and "No littering" signs and notices about fines for dropping trash appear in Part 7.
words/#53-31/q/k: 관계대명사 who 뒤 동사 자리이며 벌금을 물게 되는 행위이므로 '쓰레기를 버리다'라는 동사 litter가 정답이다. little, latter는 형용사이고 letter는 의미가 맞지 않는다.

The blank is the verb after the relative pronoun who, and the action that leads to a fine is "dropping trash," so the verb litter is correct. Little and latter are adjectives, and letter doesn't fit the meaning.
words/#53-32/exKo: 시는 오래된 컴퓨터와 텔레비전을 무료로 처리해 준다.
The city provides free disposal of old computers and televisions.
words/#53-32/tip: dispose of(Day 23)의 명사형이며, at your disposal(마음대로 이용할 수 있는)이라는 숙어가 Part 7에 자주 나온다.
It is the noun form of dispose of (Day 23), and the idiom at your disposal (available for you to use as you like) often appears in Part 7.
words/#53-32/q/k: 형용사 Proper의 수식을 받는 주어 자리이며 '폐건전지의 적절한 처리'라는 뜻이 되어야 하므로 명사 disposal이 정답이다. dispose는 동사, disposable과 disposed는 형용사다.
Modified by the adjective Proper, the subject must mean "proper handling of used batteries," so the noun disposal is correct. Dispose is a verb, and disposable and disposed are adjectives.
words/#53-33/exKo: 그 항공사는 2030년까지 탄소 배출량을 30퍼센트 줄일 계획이다.
The airline plans to cut its carbon output by 30 percent by 2030.
words/#53-33/tip: carbon emissions, carbon footprint(Day 23), carbon neutral처럼 복합 표현으로 Part 7 환경 기사에 자주 나온다.
It often appears in Part 7 environmental articles in compound expressions such as carbon emissions, carbon footprint (Day 23), and carbon neutral.
words/#53-33/q/k: 나무를 심어 배출량을 상쇄하는 것은 '탄소 중립'을 이루기 위해서이므로 carbon이 정답이다. carton(상자), cabin(오두막, 객실), canon(규범)은 형태가 비슷한 함정이다.

Offsetting emissions by planting trees is a way to become "net-zero (neutral)," so carbon is correct. Carton (box), cabin (small house; passenger room), and canon (rule; standard) are look-alike traps.
words/#53-34/m/0: gas that traps heat in the atmosphere (such as CO2)
words/#53-34/exKo: 승용차와 트럭은 그 도시 온실가스 배출의 주요 원인이다.
Cars and trucks are a major source of greenhouse gas emissions in the city.
words/#53-34/tip: 주로 greenhouse gas emissions(온실가스 배출) 형태로 쓰이며 climate change(Day 23)의 원인으로 Part 7 기사에 나온다.
It is mainly used as greenhouse gas emissions (release of heat-trapping gases) and appears in Part 7 articles as a cause of climate change (Day 23).
words/#53-34/q/k: emissions와 결합해 '온실가스 배출'을 이루는 greenhouse gas가 정답이다. green light(승인), gas station(주유소), greenery(초목)는 배출 대상이 아니다.

Greenhouse gas combines with emissions to mean "release of heat-trapping gases," so it is correct. Green light (approval), gas station (place to buy fuel), and greenery (plants) aren't things that are emitted.
words/#53-35/m/0: coal, oil, or natural gas (used for energy)
words/#53-35/exKo: 그 회사는 2035년까지 공장에서 화석 연료 사용을 중단하는 것을 목표로 한다.
The company aims to stop using fossil fuels in its factories by 2035.
words/#53-35/tip: 석탄·석유·천연가스를 가리키며 renewable energy(Day 23)와 대비되어 Part 7 에너지 기사에 나온다.
It refers to coal, oil, and natural gas, and appears in Part 7 energy articles in contrast to renewable energy (Day 23).
words/#53-35/q/k: 풍력 발전에 투자해 의존도를 줄이려는 대상은 '화석 연료'이므로 fossil fuels가 정답이다. fuel efficiency(연비), fossils(화석), fuel gauges(연료계)는 의존 대상으로 맞지 않는다.

What the country wants to depend on less by investing in wind farms is "coal, oil, and gas," so fossil fuels is correct. Fuel efficiency (distance per unit of fuel), fossils (remains of ancient life), and fuel gauges (fuel level indicators) aren't things a country depends on.
words/#53-36/exKo: 오래된 석탄 화력 발전소는 태양광 발전 단지로 대체될 것이다.
The old coal power plant will be replaced by a solar farm.
words/#53-36/tip: Part 7에서 power station으로 바꿔 표현되며, plant가 '식물'이 아니라 '공장, 시설'의 뜻으로 쓰인다는 점에 유의한다.
In Part 7 it is paraphrased as power station; note that plant here means "factory; facility," not a living plant.
words/#53-36/q/k: 건설되어 지역의 전력 공급을 늘리는 시설은 '발전소'이므로 power plant가 정답이다. power outage(정전), power cord(전원 코드), power struggle(권력 다툼)은 건설 대상이 아니다.

The facility that will be built and increase the region's electricity supply is a "power station," so power plant is correct. Power outage (blackout), power cord (electric cable), and power struggle (fight for control) aren't things that are built.
words/#53-37/exKo: 단열이 잘되면 겨울철 난방비를 낮출 수 있다.
Better insulation can lower heating costs during the winter months.
words/#53-37/der/0/m: to keep heat in; to shield from electricity
words/#53-37/tip: 불가산명사로 Part 7 에너지 절약 안내에서 난방비 절감 방법으로 나오며, 동사 insulate와 형용사 insulated(insulated windows)를 구분한다.
An uncountable noun that appears in Part 7 energy-saving notices as a way to cut heating costs; distinguish it from the verb insulate and the adjective insulated (insulated windows).
words/#53-37/q/k: 동명사 Adding의 목적어가 되는 명사 자리이므로 insulation이 정답이다. insulate는 동사이고 insulated, insulating은 분사라 단독으로 목적어가 될 수 없다.
The blank is a noun acting as the object of the gerund Adding, so insulation is correct. Insulate is a verb, and insulated and insulating are participles that can't be an object on their own.
words/#53-38/m/0: ability to continue long-term without harming the environment
words/#53-38/exKo: 그 회사는 지속 가능성을 위한 노력에 관한 연례 보고서를 발간한다.
The company publishes an annual report on its sustainability efforts.
words/#53-38/tip: 형용사 sustainable(Day 23)과 품사를 구분하며, commitment to sustainability처럼 전치사 to 뒤 명사 자리에 자주 나온다.
Distinguish its part of speech from the adjective sustainable (Day 23); it often appears in a noun slot after the preposition to, as in commitment to sustainability.
words/#53-38/q/k: commitment to의 to는 전치사이므로 뒤에 명사가 와야 해서 sustainability가 정답이다. sustainable, sustained는 형용사, sustainably는 부사다.
The to in commitment to is a preposition and must be followed by a noun, so sustainability is correct. Sustainable and sustained are adjectives, and sustainably is an adverb.
words/#53-39/m/0: contaminant; harmful substance (in air, water, or soil)
words/#53-39/exKo: 새 필터는 공장 폐수에서 오염 물질 대부분을 제거한다.
The new filters remove most pollutants from the factory's wastewater.
words/#53-39/tip: 가산명사 pollutant(오염 물질)와 불가산명사 pollution(오염)을 구분하는 문제가 나온다.
Questions test the countable noun pollutant (harmful substance) vs. the uncountable noun pollution (contamination).
words/#53-39/q/k: several 뒤에는 복수 가산명사가 와야 하므로 pollutants가 정답이다. pollution은 불가산명사라 several과 쓸 수 없고 polluted, pollute는 동사 형태다.
Several must be followed by a plural countable noun, so pollutants is correct. Pollution is uncountable and can't be used with several, and polluted and pollute are verb forms.
words/#53-40/exKo: 기름 유출 사고의 정화 작업은 몇 달이 걸릴 것으로 예상된다.
The cleanup of the oil spill is expected to take several months.
words/#53-40/tip: 명사(유출)와 동사(쏟다)로 모두 쓰이며 과거형은 spilled 또는 spilt이다. Part 1·3에서 음료를 쏟는 상황으로도 나온다.
It is used both as a noun (leak) and a verb (to pour out by accident), and the past tense is spilled or spilt. In Part 1·3 it also appears in situations where someone knocks over a drink.
words/#53-40/q/k: 보고해야 하는 '화학 물질 유출'이므로 spill이 정답이다. spell(주문, 철자를 말하다), spiral(나선), spin(회전)은 형태가 비슷한 함정이다.
It is a "chemical leak" that must be reported, so spill is correct. Spell (magic words; to say the letters of a word), spiral (coil shape), and spin (turning) are look-alike traps.
words/#54-01/exKo: 개정된 개인정보 처리 방침은 고객 데이터가 어떻게 저장되고 공유되는지 설명한다.
The updated privacy policy explains how customer data is stored and shared.
words/#54-01/tip: Part 7 웹사이트 공지와 이메일에서 개인정보 처리 방침의 변경을 알리는 문맥으로 자주 나오며, 약관(terms of service)과 함께 언급된다.
It often appears in Part 7 website notices and emails announcing changes to how personal data is handled, and it is mentioned together with the terms of service.
words/#54-01/q/k: 개인정보를 제3자에게 팔지 않는다는 약속의 근거는 '개인정보 처리 방침'이므로 privacy policy가 정답이다. return policy(반품 정책), price list(가격표), travel itinerary(여행 일정표)는 개인정보와 관련이 없다.

The basis for promising never to sell personal information to third parties is the "data protection policy," so privacy policy is correct. Return policy (rules on returning goods), price list (list of prices), and travel itinerary (trip schedule) have nothing to do with personal information.
words/#54-02/m/1: clash between duty and personal gain
words/#54-02/exKo: 이사회 구성원은 계약 건에 투표하기 전에 이해 충돌이 있으면 모두 보고해야 한다.
Board members must report any conflict of interest before voting on a contract.
words/#54-02/tip: 공적 책임과 개인적 이익이 충돌하는 상황을 뜻하며, Part 7 윤리 규정에서 avoid/disclose a conflict of interest로 쓰인다.
It means a situation where public duty clashes with personal gain, and in Part 7 codes of ethics it is used as avoid/disclose a conflict of interest.
words/#54-02/q/k: 가족이 일하는 회사의 입찰을 심사하면 공정성이 훼손되므로 '이해 충돌'을 뜻하는 conflict of interest가 정답이다. point of view(관점), piece of advice(조언 한마디), sense of urgency(긴박감)는 심사를 거절할 이유가 되지 않는다.

Reviewing a bid from the company where her brother works would harm fairness, so conflict of interest, meaning "clash between duty and personal gain," is correct. The phrases point of view (opinion), piece of advice (suggestion), and sense of urgency (feeling of hurry) aren't reasons to decline a review.
words/#54-03/exKo: 투자자들은 합병 계약서에 서명하기 전 3개월 동안 실사를 진행했다.
The investors spent three months on due diligence before signing the merger agreement.
words/#54-03/tip: 인수·합병이나 투자 전에 대상 기업을 면밀히 조사하는 '실사'를 뜻하며 conduct/perform due diligence로 쓴다. 불가산명사로 관사 없이 쓴다.
It means the "thorough investigation" of a target company before a merger, acquisition, or investment, used as conduct/perform due diligence. It is uncountable and used without an article.
words/#54-03/q/k: 인수 전에 재무 상태를 꼼꼼히 조사하는 것은 '실사'이므로 due diligence가 정답이다. due date(만기일), deadline(마감일)은 conduct의 목적어로 맞지 않고 overdue(기한이 지난)는 형용사다.

Carefully examining a startup's finances before acquiring it is a "pre-deal investigation," so due diligence is correct. Due date (date payment is owed) and deadline (time limit) don't fit as the object of conduct, and overdue (late) is an adjective.
words/#54-04/m/1: to put at a disadvantage; to fine
words/#54-04/exKo: 세금을 제때 신고하지 않는 회사는 처벌을 받는다.
Companies that fail to file their taxes on time will be penalized.
words/#54-04/tip: penalize A for B(B에 대해 A를 처벌하다) 구문으로 쓰이며 명사 penalty(Day 24)와 품사를 구분한다.
It is used in the pattern penalize A for B (punish A for B), and its part of speech is tested vs. the noun penalty (Day 24).
words/#54-04/q/k: will be 뒤에서 승객이 '처벌을 받는다'는 수동태가 되어야 하므로 과거분사 penalized가 정답이다. penalty, penalties는 명사, penal(형벌의)은 형용사로 for와 어울려 의미가 통하지 않는다.

After will be, it must be passive, meaning passengers "are punished," so the past participle penalized is correct. Penalty and penalties are nouns, and penal (relating to punishment) is an adjective that makes no sense with for.
words/#54-05/exKo: It is illegal to park in front of a fire hydrant.
words/#54-05/tip: 부사 illegally(illegally parked 불법 주차된)와의 품사 자리 구분이 출제되며 Part 7에서 unlawful, prohibited로 바꿔 표현된다.
Questions test it vs. the adverb illegally (illegally parked = parked against the law), and in Part 7 it is paraphrased as unlawful or prohibited.
words/#54-05/q/k: be동사 is 뒤 보어 자리에 주어의 성격을 설명하는 형용사가 필요하므로 illegal이 정답이다. illegally는 부사라 보어가 될 수 없고 illegality, illegalities는 명사라 주어와 동격이 되지 않는다.

After the be verb is, the complement must be an adjective describing the subject, so illegal is correct. Illegally is an adverb and can't be a complement, and illegality and illegalities are nouns that can't be equated with the subject.
words/#54-06/exKo: 공장들은 안전 기준을 지키지 않으면 무거운 벌금을 물게 된다.
Factories face heavy fines for noncompliance with safety standards.
words/#54-06/tip: noncompliance with(~을 지키지 않음)처럼 전치사 with와 함께 쓰이며 Part 7에서 failure to comply로 바꿔 표현된다.
It is used with the preposition with, as in noncompliance with (failure to follow), and in Part 7 it is paraphrased as failure to comply.
words/#54-06/q/k: 건축 규정을 반복해서 '지키지 않으면' 면허를 잃을 수 있다는 뜻이며 with와 어울리는 noncompliance가 정답이다. nonprofit(비영리의), nonstop(직행의), nonsense(터무니없는 말)는 의미가 맞지 않는다.

Contractors can lose their licenses for repeatedly "failing to follow" building regulations, and noncompliance goes with with, so it is correct. Nonprofit (not for profit), nonstop (direct; without stopping), and nonsense (foolish talk) don't fit the meaning.
words/#54-07/m/1: to adjust; to keep at a set level
words/#54-07/exKo: The government regulates the prices of electricity and gas.
words/#54-07/der/2/m: official body that oversees an industry
words/#54-07/tip: '규제하다' 외에 regulate the temperature(온도를 조절하다)의 뜻도 있으며, 명사 regulation(Day 24), 형용사 regulatory와 품사를 구분한다.

Besides "to control by rules," it also means "to adjust," as in regulate the temperature (keep the temperature at a set level), and its part of speech is tested vs. the noun regulation (Day 24) and the adjective regulatory.
words/#54-07/q/k: 주어 A thermostat와 부사 automatically 뒤 동사 자리이므로 3인칭 단수 동사 regulates가 정답이다. regulation, regulator는 명사, regulatory는 형용사다.

After the subject A thermostat and the adverb automatically, the blank is the verb, so the third-person singular regulates is correct. Regulation and regulator are nouns, and regulatory is an adjective.
words/#54-08/exKo: 은행은 규제 당국에 월별 보고서를 제출해야 한다.
Banks must submit monthly reports to regulatory authorities.
words/#54-08/tip: 명사 앞 형용사 자리에 regulatory approval/agency/requirements처럼 쓰이며, 명사 regulation과 품사를 구분하는 문제가 나온다.
It is used in the adjective slot before nouns, as in regulatory approval/agency/requirements, and questions test its part of speech vs. the noun regulation.
words/#54-08/q/k: 명사 clearance(허가)를 수식하는 형용사 자리이므로 regulatory가 정답이다. regulate, regulates는 동사이고 regularly(정기적으로)는 부사다.
The blank is an adjective modifying the noun clearance (official permission), so regulatory is correct. Regulate and regulates are verbs, and regularly (on a regular basis) is an adverb.
words/#54-09/exKo: 새 규정은 모든 식품 공급업체에 알레르기 유발 성분을 명확히 표시하도록 요구한다.
New regulations require all food suppliers to label allergens clearly.
words/#54-09/tip: be required to do(~해야 한다), require that + 주어 + (should) 동사원형 구문이 출제된다. 명사 requirement(Day 1)와 품사도 구분한다.
The patterns be required to do (must do) and require that + subject + (should) + base verb are tested. Also distinguish its part of speech from the noun requirement (Day 1).
words/#54-09/q/k: 주어 Most of the job openings는 복수(openings)이므로 복수 동사 require가 정답이다. listed는 openings를 꾸미는 과거분사다. requires는 수가 맞지 않고, requiring은 동사 자리에 올 수 없으며 requirement는 명사다.

The subject Most of the job openings is plural (openings), so the plural verb require is correct; listed is a past participle modifying openings. Requires doesn't agree in number, requiring can't fill a verb slot, and requirement is a noun.
words/#54-10/m/0: release form (giving up a right or claim)
words/#54-10/exKo: 참가자들은 암벽 등반 강좌에 참여하기 전에 면책 동의서에 서명해야 한다.
Participants must sign a waiver before joining the rock-climbing class.
words/#54-10/der/0/m: to give up (a right); to cancel (a fee)
words/#54-10/tip: 동사 waive(Day 24)의 명사형으로 sign a waiver(면책 동의서에 서명하다), fee waiver(수수료 면제)처럼 쓰인다. 발음이 같은 waver(흔들리다)와 혼동하지 말 것.

It is the noun form of the verb waive (Day 24), used as in sign a waiver (sign a release form) and fee waiver (cancellation of a fee). Don't confuse it with waver (hesitate; sway), which sounds the same.
words/#54-10/q/k: 관사 a 뒤 명사 자리이며 '신청비 면제'라는 뜻이 되어야 하므로 waiver가 정답이다. waive, waived, waiving은 동사 형태다.
After the article a, the blank is a noun meaning "an exemption from the application fee," so waiver is correct. The words waive, waived, and waiving are verb forms.
words/#54-11/exKo: 공항 규정은 승객이 100밀리리터가 넘는 액체를 휴대하는 것을 금지한다.
Airport rules forbid passengers from carrying more than 100 milliliters of liquid.
words/#54-11/tip: forbid A to do와 forbid A from -ing 모두 가능하며, 과거형은 forbade, 과거분사는 forbidden이다.
Both forbid A to do and forbid A from -ing are possible; the past tense is forbade and the past participle is forbidden.
words/#54-11/q/k: be동사 is 뒤에서 흡연이 '금지된다'는 수동태가 되어야 하므로 과거분사 forbidden이 정답이다. forbade는 과거형, forbid는 원형이라 be동사 뒤에 올 수 없고 forbidding은 '험악한'이라는 뜻의 형용사다.

After the be verb is, the passive meaning "smoking is prohibited" is needed, so the past participle forbidden is correct. Forbade is the past tense and forbid is the base form, so neither can follow be, and forbidding is an adjective meaning "threatening; unfriendly".
words/#54-12/exKo: 그 예산안은 아직 재무 이사의 승인이 필요하다.
The budget proposal still needs approval from the finance director.
words/#54-12/tip: approve는 타동사(approve the plan) 또는 approve of(~에 찬성하다)로 쓰이며, 명사 approval은 obtain/get approval, subject to approval 형태로 출제된다.
Approve is used transitively (approve the plan) or as approve of (agree with), and the noun approval is tested in forms like obtain/get approval and subject to approval.
words/#54-12/q/k: 형용사 prior의 수식을 받고 need의 목적어가 되는 명사 자리이므로 approval이 정답이다. approve, approves는 동사, approved는 과거분사다.
Modified by the adjective prior and acting as the object of need, the blank is a noun, so approval is correct. Approve and approves are verbs, and approved is a past participle.
words/#54-13/m/1: firm acting for clients; branch office
words/#54-13/exKo: 그 연방 기관은 다음 달 새로운 식품 표시 규정을 발표한다.
The federal agency will publish new food labeling rules next month.
words/#54-13/tip: travel agency(여행사), advertising agency(광고 대행사), government agency(정부 기관)처럼 복합명사로 쓰이며 사람명사 agent와 구분한다.
It is used in compound nouns like travel agency (travel company), advertising agency (ad firm), and government agency (government body); distinguish it from the person noun agent.
words/#54-13/q/k: travel과 결합해 '여행사'를 이루고 가격을 비교할 수 있는 곳이므로 agencies가 정답이다. agendas(안건), agreements(합의), assignments(과제)는 travel과 결합해 장소를 나타내지 못한다.

It combines with travel to mean "travel companies," places where you can compare prices, so agencies is correct. Agendas (lists of topics for a meeting), agreements (deals), and assignments (tasks) can't combine with travel to name a place.
words/#54-14/exKo: 연구실 직원은 화학 물질을 다룰 때 엄격한 안전 수칙을 따라야 한다.
Lab staff must follow strict safety protocols when handling chemicals.
words/#54-14/tip: Part 7에서 procedure, guidelines로 바꿔 표현되며 follow/observe protocol 형태로 쓰인다. 외교상의 '의례'라는 뜻도 있다.
In Part 7 it is paraphrased as procedure or guidelines and used as follow/observe protocol. It also means diplomatic "etiquette".
words/#54-14/q/k: 보안 사고를 한 시간 안에 보고하도록 정한 회사의 '규약, 절차'이므로 protocol이 정답이다. prototype(시제품), proportion(비율), prosperity(번영)는 의미가 맞지 않는다.

It is the company's "procedure" requiring security breaches to be reported within an hour, so protocol is correct. Prototype (first model), proportion (ratio), and prosperity (wealth; success) don't fit the meaning.
words/#54-15/exKo: 그 식당은 시의 보건 규정을 충족하지 못해 문을 닫았다.
The restaurant was closed after failing to meet the city's health code.
words/#54-15/tip: building/health code(건축·보건 법규), code of conduct(행동 강령)처럼 '규정'의 뜻으로 자주 쓰이며 zip code, access code의 '부호' 뜻도 있다.

It is often used to mean "regulations," as in building/health code (construction/health regulations) and code of conduct (rules of behavior), and also "number or symbol," as in zip code and access code.
words/#54-15/q/k: building과 결합해 '건축 법규'를 이루고 meet(충족하다)의 목적어가 되는 codes가 정답이다. chords(화음), coats(외투, 칠), cords(끈, 전선)는 충족해야 할 대상이 아니다.

Codes combines with building to mean "construction regulations" and is the object of meet (satisfy), so it is correct. Chords (musical notes played together), coats (jackets; layers of paint), and cords (strings; cables) aren't things you must meet.
words/#54-16/m/0: rules about what to wear; attire policy
words/#54-16/exKo: 그 회사는 금요일에 청바지를 입을 수 있도록 복장 규정을 완화했다.
The company relaxed its dress code to allow jeans on Fridays.
words/#54-16/tip: Part 3·7에서 복장 규정의 변경·준수 안내로 나오며 attire, business casual 같은 표현과 함께 쓰인다.
In Part 3·7 it appears in notices about changing or following rules on clothing and is used together with expressions such as attire and business casual.
words/#54-16/q/k: 모든 종업원의 복장을 정해 놓은 '복장 규정'이므로 dress code가 정답이다. zip code(우편 번호), dressing room(탈의실), dress rehearsal(총연습)은 복장 기준을 정하지 않는다.

It sets what all servers must wear, so dress code, meaning "rules about what to wear," is correct. Zip code (postal code), dressing room (changing room), and dress rehearsal (final full practice) don't set clothing standards.
words/#54-17/exKo: 모든 신입 사원은 기업 윤리에 관한 온라인 강좌를 이수해야 한다.
All new hires must complete an online course on business ethics.
words/#54-17/tip: '윤리 규범'의 뜻일 때는 복수 취급하고 '윤리학'일 때는 단수 취급한다. code of ethics(윤리 강령)가 Part 7 빈출 표현이다.
When it means "rules of conduct" it is treated as plural, and when it means "the study of morality" it is singular. The phrase code of ethics (set of moral rules) is a common Part 7 expression.
words/#54-17/q/k: 전치사 of 뒤에 와서 '윤리 강령'(code of ethics)을 이루는 명사 ethics가 정답이다. ethical은 형용사, ethically는 부사이고 ethicist(윤리학자)는 의미가 맞지 않는다.
After the preposition of, the noun ethics forms "code of ethics," so it is correct. Ethical is an adjective, ethically is an adverb, and ethicist (expert on moral questions) doesn't fit the meaning.
words/#54-18/exKo: 고객들은 윤리적인 경영 방식을 따르는 브랜드를 점점 더 선호한다.
Customers increasingly prefer brands that follow ethical business practices.
words/#54-18/tip: 명사 앞 형용사 자리 문제로 출제되며 반의어 unethical, 부사 ethically와 함께 알아 두자.
It is tested in questions on the adjective slot before a noun; learn it with its opposite unethical and the adverb ethically.
words/#54-18/q/k: 소유격 its와 명사 treatment 사이 형용사 자리이므로 ethical이 정답이다. ethics, ethicist는 명사, ethically는 부사라 명사를 수식할 수 없다.
Between the possessive its and the noun treatment, the blank is an adjective, so ethical is correct. Ethics and ethicist are nouns, and ethically is an adverb, so none can modify a noun.
words/#54-19/exKo: Larson 씨는 모든 사업 거래에서 정직하고 청렴하기로 알려져 있다.
Mr. Larson is known for his honesty and integrity in all his business dealings.
words/#54-19/tip: 사람의 '청렴, 정직'뿐 아니라 structural integrity(구조적 안전성), data integrity(데이터 무결성)의 뜻으로도 쓰인다.
It means not only a person's "honesty" but also structural integrity (structural soundness) and data integrity (accuracy and consistency of data).
words/#54-19/q/k: 폭풍 후 다리의 '구조적 안전성'을 확인한다는 뜻이므로 structural integrity를 이루는 integrity가 정답이다. integration(통합), intensity(강도), intention(의도)은 의미가 맞지 않는다.

After the storm, they check the bridge's "structural soundness," so integrity, forming structural integrity, is correct. Integration (combining), intensity (strength), and intention (purpose) don't fit the meaning.
words/#54-20/exKo: 주주들은 경영진 보수 결정 방식의 투명성을 높이라고 요구해 왔다.
Shareholders have called for greater transparency in how executive pay is set.
words/#54-20/tip: 형용사 transparent와 품사를 구분하며 Part 7에서 openness로 바꿔 표현된다. greater/increased transparency처럼 형용사 수식이 흔하다.
Distinguish its part of speech from the adjective transparent; in Part 7 it is paraphrased as openness. It is often modified by adjectives, as in greater/increased transparency.
words/#54-20/q/k: improve의 목적어로 '투명성'이라는 불가산 추상명사가 필요하므로 transparency가 정답이다. transparent는 형용사, transparently는 부사이고 transparencies는 '투명 필름'을 뜻하는 가산명사라 의미가 맞지 않는다.

The object of improve must be the uncountable abstract noun meaning "openness," so transparency is correct. Transparent is an adjective, transparently is an adverb, and transparencies is a countable noun meaning "clear plastic sheets," which doesn't fit.
words/#54-21/exKo: 새 보고 체계는 부서장들의 책임성을 높인다.
The new reporting system increases accountability among department heads.
words/#54-21/tip: 형용사 accountable은 be accountable for/to(~에 대해/~에게 책임이 있다)로 쓰이며 명사 accountability와의 품사 구분이 출제된다. 회계사(accountant)와 혼동하지 말 것.

The adjective accountable is used as be accountable for/to (be responsible for / answerable to), and questions test its part of speech vs. the noun accountability. Don't confuse it with accountant (person who keeps financial records).
words/#54-21/q/k: 형용사 greater의 수식을 받고 promised의 목적어가 되는 명사 자리이므로 accountability가 정답이다. accountable은 형용사, accountably는 부사이고 accountant(회계사)는 의미가 맞지 않는다.

Modified by the adjective greater and acting as the object of promised, the blank is a noun, so accountability is correct. Accountable is an adjective, accountably is an adverb, and accountant (financial record-keeper) doesn't fit the meaning.
words/#54-22/exKo: 그 공급업체는 비윤리적인 노동 관행이 보도된 후 거래가 끊겼다.
The supplier was dropped after reports of unethical labor practices.
words/#54-22/tip: un-은 부정 접두사로 반의어 ethical과 짝을 이루며, Part 7에서 improper, dishonest로 바꿔 표현된다.
Un- is a negative prefix, so it pairs with the opposite ethical; in Part 7 it is paraphrased as improper or dishonest.
words/#54-22/q/k: 회사 지침상 납품업체에게서 비싼 선물을 받는 행위는 '비윤리적인' 것으로 간주되므로 unethical이 정답이다. unlimited(무제한의), unanimous(만장일치의), unoccupied(비어 있는)는 행위를 평가하는 말로 맞지 않는다.

Under the company's guidelines, accepting expensive gifts from vendors is considered "morally wrong," so unethical is correct. Unlimited (without limits), unanimous (agreed by everyone), and unoccupied (empty) don't work as judgments of an action.
words/#54-23/exKo: 그 고객은 분실 수하물 문제로 항공사를 고소하겠다고 했다.
The customer threatened to sue the airline over the lost luggage.
words/#54-23/der/1/m: legal case; set of formal clothes
words/#54-23/tip: 타동사로 sue the company처럼 목적어를 바로 쓰며, sue A for B(B를 이유로 A를 고소하다)로 쓴다. 명사는 lawsuit 또는 suit이다.
It is transitive and takes an object directly, as in sue the company, and is used as sue A for B (take A to court over B). The noun is lawsuit or suit.
words/#54-23/q/k: sue A for B(B를 이유로 A를 고소하다) 구문이므로 sue가 정답이다. suit는 동사로 '어울리다'라는 뜻이고, accuse는 accuse A of B로 써야 하며, argue는 사람을 목적어로 취하지 않는다.

It is the pattern sue A for B (take A to court over B), so sue is correct. As a verb, suit means "to look good on; to be convenient for," accuse must be used as accuse A of B, and argue doesn't take a person as its object.
words/#54-24/m/1: person who sees an event; observer
words/#54-24/exKo: 계약서는 증인이 입회한 상태에서 서명해야 한다.
The contract must be signed in the presence of a witness.
words/#54-24/col/0/k: in the presence of a witness
words/#54-24/tip: 명사(증인, 목격자)와 동사(목격하다, 증인으로 서명하다)로 모두 쓰이며, '(지역·업계가 변화를) 겪다'라는 비유적 동사 의미도 Part 7에 나온다.

It is used both as a noun (person who saw something) and a verb (to see happen; to sign as a witness), and the figurative verb meaning "(a place or industry) to experience (a change)" also appears in Part 7.
words/#54-24/q/k: 새 공항 개항 이후 해안 도시가 관광객의 급증을 '겪었다'는 뜻이 되어야 하므로 witnessed가 정답이다. attended(참석했다), spectated(관전했다)는 도시를 주어로 쓸 수 없고 testified(증언했다)는 목적어 rise와 어울리지 않는다.

The coastal town "has experienced" a sharp rise in tourists since the new airport opened, so witnessed is correct. Attended (went to) and spectated (watched as a spectator) can't take a town as the subject, and testified (gave evidence) doesn't go with the object rise.
words/#54-25/exKo: 배송 지연이 그 운송 회사 때문이라는 증거는 없다.
There is no evidence that the delay was caused by the shipping company.
words/#54-25/tip: 불가산명사라 an evidence, evidences로 쓰지 않고 a piece of evidence로 센다. 형용사 evident와 품사를 구분하는 문제가 나온다.
It is uncountable, so it is never an evidence or evidences; count it as a piece of evidence. Questions test its part of speech vs. the adjective evident.
words/#54-25/q/k: provide의 목적어로 of 이하의 수식을 받는 명사가 필요하므로 evidence가 정답이다. evident는 형용사, evidently는 부사, evidenced는 과거분사다.
The object of provide must be a noun modified by the of phrase, so evidence is correct. Evident is an adjective, evidently is an adverb, and evidenced is a past participle.
words/#54-26/exKo: 급여 정보를 다루는 직원은 항상 엄격하게 비밀을 유지해야 한다.
Staff who handle salary information must maintain strict confidentiality at all times.
words/#54-26/tip: 형용사 confidential(Day 24)과 품사를 구분하며, confidentiality agreement(비밀 유지 계약)가 Part 7 빈출 표현이다.
Distinguish its part of speech from the adjective confidential (Day 24); confidentiality agreement (nondisclosure agreement) is a common Part 7 expression.
words/#54-26/q/k: respect의 목적어로 client와 결합해 '고객 비밀 보장'을 이루는 명사 confidentiality가 정답이다. confidential, confident는 형용사, confidently는 부사다.
As the object of respect, the noun confidentiality combines with client to mean "client privacy," so it is correct. Confidential and confident are adjectives, and confidently is an adverb.
words/#54-27/exKo: 그 분쟁은 주 법원의 관할에 속한다.
The dispute falls under the jurisdiction of the state court.
words/#54-27/tip: under/within the jurisdiction of(~의 관할하에) 형태로 전치사와 함께 쓰이며, Part 7에서 authority로 바꿔 표현된다.
It is used with prepositions, as in under/within the jurisdiction of (under the authority of), and in Part 7 it is paraphrased as authority.
words/#54-27/q/k: fall under the jurisdiction of(~의 관할에 속하다) 표현이므로 jurisdiction이 정답이다. justification(정당화), junction(교차로), juncture(시점)는 의미가 맞지 않는다.

It is the expression fall under the jurisdiction of (come under the authority of), so jurisdiction is correct. Justification (reason; excuse), junction (intersection), and juncture (point in time) don't fit the meaning.
words/#54-28/exKo: 새 시 조례는 주거 지역에서 오전 8시 이전에 낙엽 송풍기를 사용하는 것을 금지한다.
A new city ordinance bans the use of leaf blowers in residential areas before 8 A.M.
words/#54-28/tip: 시·군 등 지방 자치 단체의 법규를 뜻하며, 철자가 비슷한 ordnance(무기)나 ordinary(평범한)와 혼동하지 말 것.
It refers to the laws of a city or other local government; don't confuse it with the look-alikes ordnance (weapons) and ordinary (normal).
words/#54-28/q/k: 업체에 보도 제설 의무를 지우는 '지방 조례'이므로 ordinance가 정답이다. ordinary(평범한)는 형용사이고 ordeal(시련), ornament(장식품)는 의미가 맞지 않는다.

It is a "local regulation" requiring businesses to keep their sidewalks clear of snow, so ordinance is correct. Ordinary (normal) is an adjective, and ordeal (painful experience) and ornament (decoration) don't fit the meaning.
words/#54-29/m/0: revision; change (to a law or rule)
words/#54-29/exKo: The board approved an amendment to the company's bylaws.
words/#54-29/der/0/m: to revise; to change (a law or document)
words/#54-29/tip: an amendment to the contract(계약 수정 조항)처럼 전치사 to와 함께 쓰이며 동사 amend와 품사를 구분한다.
It is used with the preposition to, as in an amendment to the contract (a change to the contract), and its part of speech is tested vs. the verb amend.
words/#54-29/q/k: any 뒤 sign의 목적어가 되는 명사 자리이며 '계약서 수정 조항'이라는 뜻이 되어야 하므로 amendment가 정답이다. amend, amended는 동사 형태이고 amends는 make amends(보상하다)로 쓰이는 명사라 의미가 맞지 않는다.

After any, the blank is a noun acting as the object of sign and meaning "a change to the contract," so amendment is correct. Amend and amended are verb forms, and amends is a noun used in make amends (make up for a wrong), which doesn't fit.
words/#54-30/exKo: Cole 씨는 고객에게 보내기 전에 계약서를 몇 군데 수정했다.
Ms. Cole made several revisions to the contract before sending it to the client.
words/#54-30/tip: make revisions to(~을 수정하다)처럼 쓰이며 동사 revise, 형용사 revised(revised schedule 수정된 일정)와 품사를 구분한다.
It is used as in make revisions to (make changes to), and its part of speech is tested vs. the verb revise and the adjective revised (revised schedule = updated schedule).
words/#54-30/q/k: several 뒤에는 복수 가산명사가 와야 하므로 revisions가 정답이다. revise는 동사, revised는 과거분사, revising은 동명사로 several과 함께 쓸 수 없다.
Several must be followed by a plural countable noun, so revisions is correct. Revise is a verb, revised is a past participle, and revising is a gerund, so none can be used with several.
words/#54-31/exKo: 지역 농민들의 거센 항의 끝에 정부는 새 유류세를 폐지하기로 했다.
After strong protests from local farmers, the government agreed to repeal the new fuel tax.
words/#54-31/tip: 법률·규정을 공식적으로 '폐지하다'라는 뜻으로 반의어 enact(Day 24)와 짝을 이룬다. 철자가 비슷한 repel(물리치다), appeal과 혼동하지 말 것.
It means to officially "abolish" a law or rule and pairs with its opposite enact (Day 24). Don't confuse it with the look-alikes repel (drive back) and appeal.
words/#54-31/q/k: 의원들이 낡은 규칙을 '폐지할' 것이라는 뜻이므로 repeal이 정답이다. repel(물리치다), repair(수리하다), reveal(드러내다)은 rule을 목적어로 쓰기에 의미가 맞지 않는다.
Lawmakers are expected to "abolish" the outdated rule, so repeal is correct. Repel (drive back), repair (fix), and reveal (show) don't make sense with rule as the object.
words/#54-32/exKo: 그 식당은 여러 차례 점검에서 불합격한 후 영업 허가가 취소되었다.
The restaurant's license was revoked after it failed several inspections.
words/#54-32/tip: 면허·허가·권한을 공식적으로 '취소하다'라는 뜻으로 주로 수동태 be revoked로 쓰인다. 형태가 비슷한 evoke, invoke, provoke와 구분한다.
It means to officially "cancel" a license, permit, or right and is mostly used in the passive, be revoked. Distinguish it from the look-alikes evoke, invoke, and provoke.
words/#54-32/q/k: 안전 경고를 무시하는 업체의 허가를 '취소할' 수 있다는 뜻이므로 revoke가 정답이다. evoke(불러일으키다), invoke(언급하다, 발동하다), provoke(유발하다)는 permit과 어울리지 않는다.

The agency may "cancel" the permit of any company that ignores safety warnings, so revoke is correct. Evoke (bring to mind), invoke (cite; put into effect), and provoke (cause; anger) don't go with permit.
words/#54-33/exKo: 법원은 그 디자인이 경쟁사의 특허를 침해했다고 판결했다.
The court ruled that the design infringed the competitor's patent.
words/#54-33/tip: infringe a patent처럼 타동사로도, infringe on/upon(~을 침해하다)처럼 자동사로도 쓰이며 명사 infringement와 품사 구분이 출제된다.
It is used transitively, as in infringe a patent, and intransitively, as in infringe on/upon (violate), and part-of-speech questions test it vs. the noun infringement.
words/#54-33/q/k: 조동사 could 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 하므로 infringe가 정답이다. infringement는 명사, infringed와 infringing은 조동사 뒤에 올 수 없다.
The modal could must be followed by a base verb, so infringe is correct. Infringement is a noun, and infringed and infringing can't follow a modal.
words/#54-34/exKo: 소방 차로에 주차하는 것은 시 교통 규칙 위반이다.
Parking in a fire lane is a violation of city traffic rules.
words/#54-34/tip: in violation of(~을 위반하여) 숙어가 Part 5에 출제되며 동사 violate(Day 24)와 품사를 구분한다.
The idiom in violation of (breaking ~) is tested in Part 5, and its part of speech is tested vs. the verb violate (Day 24).
words/#54-34/q/k: in violation of(~을 위반하여)라는 숙어이므로 violation이 정답이다. violator(위반자)는 사람이라 의미가 맞지 않고 violate, violated는 동사 형태다.
It is the idiom in violation of (breaking ~), so violation is correct. Violator (person who breaks a rule) is a person and doesn't fit, and violate and violated are verb forms.
words/#54-35/exKo: 그 항공사는 수하물 처리 오류에 대한 조사에 착수했다.
The airline has opened an investigation into the baggage handling error.
words/#54-35/der/1/m: person who looks into a case
words/#54-35/tip: investigation into(~에 대한 조사), under investigation(조사 중인) 형태가 자주 나오며 사람명사 investigator와 구분한다.
Investigation into (inquiry into) and under investigation (being looked into) are common, and it is distinguished from the person noun investigator.
words/#54-35/q/k: under investigation(조사 중인)이라는 표현이므로 전치사 under 뒤에 명사 investigation이 정답이다. investigator(조사관)는 사람이라 의미가 맞지 않고 investigate는 동사, investigative는 형용사다.

It is the expression under investigation (being looked into), so the noun investigation after the preposition under is correct. Investigator (person who looks into a case) is a person and doesn't fit, investigate is a verb, and investigative is an adjective.
words/#54-36/exKo: 직원은 질병과 같은 정당한 사유가 있을 때만 회의에 불참할 수 있다.
Employees may miss a meeting only for a legitimate reason, such as illness.
words/#54-36/tip: '합법적인'뿐 아니라 legitimate reason/concern(정당한 이유, 타당한 우려)처럼 '정당한, 타당한'의 뜻으로 자주 쓰인다.
Besides "lawful," it often means "valid; reasonable," as in legitimate reason/concern (justified reason / valid concern).
words/#54-36/q/k: 제품 안전에 대해 고객이 제기한 '타당한' 우려라는 뜻이므로 legitimate가 정답이다. legendary(전설적인), legible(읽기 쉬운), leisurely(느긋한)는 concerns를 수식하기에 의미가 맞지 않는다.
Customers raised "valid" concerns about the product's safety, so legitimate is correct. Legendary (famous), legible (easy to read), and leisurely (relaxed) don't make sense describing concerns.
words/#54-37/exKo: 주차 허가증은 대시보드 위에 보이게 두지 않으면 효력이 없다.
Your parking permit is invalid if it is not displayed on the dashboard.
words/#54-37/der/0/m: to cancel the validity of; to make void
words/#54-37/tip: 반의어 valid와 짝을 이루며, 동사 invalidate(무효로 하다)와 품사 구분이 출제된다. '병약자'라는 뜻의 명사 invalid는 강세가 첫음절에 온다.
It pairs with its opposite valid, and its part of speech is tested vs. the verb invalidate (make void). The noun invalid, meaning "sick or disabled person," is stressed on the first syllable.
words/#54-37/q/k: be considered 뒤 보어 자리에 표의 상태를 나타내는 형용사가 필요하고 비공식 판매처에서 산 표이므로 '무효인'이라는 invalid가 정답이다. invaluable(매우 귀중한)은 의미가 맞지 않고 invalidate는 동사, invalidation은 명사다.

After be considered, the complement must be an adjective describing the tickets, and since they were bought from unofficial sellers, invalid, meaning "void," is correct. Invaluable (extremely precious) doesn't fit the meaning, invalidate is a verb, and invalidation is a noun.
words/#54-38/m/0: to require (by law); to make compulsory
words/#54-38/exKo: 새 법은 모든 식당이 칼로리 정보를 표시하도록 의무화한다.
The new law mandates that all restaurants display calorie information.
words/#54-38/tip: mandate that + 주어 + (should) 동사원형 구문으로 쓰이며 명사로는 '명령, 권한'을 뜻한다. 형용사 mandatory(의무적인)도 Part 5에 자주 출제된다.
It is used in the pattern mandate that + subject + (should) + base verb, and as a noun it means "order; authority." The adjective mandatory (compulsory) also often appears in Part 5.
