Asked when the rates take effect, (B) is correct: it gives a time, the start of next quarter. (A) suggests a commission rate figure but doesn't say when, and (C) is a trap that answers a wh-question with Yes and uses effective, which looks like effect.

The correct answer doesn't give the reason directly; it asks back whether you've seen the revised travel budget, hinting that the budget was cut. This is an indirect response. 'Rome is lovely in the spring.' is a trap that repeats Rome, and 'About three days ago, I think.' repeats three days and gives a time (an answer to When).

full/#f8/p2/#fm8-p2-04/exp: 연기된 이유(Why)를 묻자 강사가 독감에 걸렸다고 이유를 말한 (A)가 정답이다. (B)는 오리엔테이션에서 연상되는 장소를 말한 Where 응답이고, (C)는 new hires를 반복해 인원수를 말한 How many 응답이다.

Asked why (Why) it was postponed, (A) is correct: it gives the reason, the trainer got the flu. (B) is a Where answer naming a place you might associate with orientation, and (C) repeats new hires and gives a number, answering How many.
full/#f8/p2/#fm8-p2-05/qko: 제가 출발하기 전에 탑승권 좀 출력해 주실래요?
Could you print my boarding pass before I leave?
full/#f8/p2/#fm8-p2-05/ok/0: 제 버스 정기권은 다음 달에 만료돼요.
My bus pass expires next month.
full/#f8/p2/#fm8-p2-05/exp: 탑승권을 출력해 달라는 부탁에 Sure로 수락하고 출력에 필요한 예약 확인 번호를 물은 것이 정답이다. 'My bus pass expires next month.'는 pass를 '정기권'이라는 다른 뜻으로 반복한 함정이고, 'The board meets at two.'는 boarding과 발음이 비슷한 board(이사회)를 이용한 오답이다.

Asked to print a boarding pass, the correct answer agrees with Sure and asks for the confirmation number needed to print it. 'My bus pass expires next month.' is a trap that repeats pass with a different meaning (a travel pass), and 'The board meets at two.' uses board (board of directors), which sounds like boarding.
full/#f8/p2/#fm8-p2-06/qko: 토요일에 제 대신 계산대 근무를 서 주실 수 있어요?
Would you mind covering my shift at the register on Saturday?
full/#f8/p2/#fm8-p2-06/ok/0: 제가 이번 주말에 다른 지역에 가 있어요.
I'm going out of town this weekend.
full/#f8/p2/#fm8-p2-06/ok/1: Shift it a little to the left.
full/#f8/p2/#fm8-p2-06/exp: 토요일 근무를 대신해 달라는 부탁에 '이번 주말에 다른 곳에 간다'며 할 수 없음을 돌려 말한 (A)가 정답이다. (B)는 shift 를 '옮기다'라는 뜻으로, (C)는 register 를 '등록하다'라는 뜻으로 반복한 함정이다.

Asked to cover a Saturday shift, (A) is correct: by saying they're going out of town this weekend, the speaker indirectly declines. (B) repeats shift in the sense of "move," and (C) repeats register in the sense of "sign up"; both are traps.
full/#f8/p2/#fm8-p2-07/qko: 개리슨 씨가 파손된 헤드폰을 환불받고 싶어 해요.

Told that he wants a refund for damaged headphones, (C) is correct: it asks about what's needed to process a refund, the original receipt. (A) talks about listening to music, which you might associate with headphones, and (B) is a trap using fund (to pay for), which sounds like refund.
full/#f8/p2/#fm8-p2-08/qko: 길퍼드 지점에서 안내 책자를 더 보내 달라고 했어요.
The Gilford branch has asked for more brochures.
full/#f8/p2/#fm8-p2-08/ok/1: 인쇄소에 한 번 더 인쇄해 달라고 할게요.
I'll ask the printer for another batch.
full/#f8/p2/#fm8-p2-08/exp: 책자를 더 요청했다는 말에 '인쇄소에 추가 인쇄를 요청하겠다'고 대응한 (B)가 정답이다. (A)는 branch 를 반복한 개점 연도 응답이고, (C)는 brochure 를 반복했지만 요청에 대한 대응이 아니다.

Told that more brochures were requested, (B) is correct: it responds by offering to ask the printer for another batch. (A) repeats branch and gives the year it opened, and (C) repeats brochure but doesn't respond to the request.
full/#f8/p2/#fm8-p2-09/qko: 이 경비 보고서들은 당신이 정리하나요, 아니면 빌랄이 하나요?
Are you filing these expense reports, or is Bilal?
full/#f8/p2/#fm8-p2-09/exp: 보고서 정리를 누가 하는지 묻자 빌랄이 오늘 아파서 결근했다며 '그래서 내가 한다'는 뜻을 돌려 말한 (B)가 정답이다. (A)는 filing을 반복한 오답이고, (C)는 선택 의문문에 No로 답하면서 expense와 형태가 비슷한 expensive를 이용한 함정이다.

Asked who is filing the reports, (B) is correct: by saying Bilal is out sick today, the speaker indirectly means "So I'm doing it." (A) repeats filing, and (C) is a trap that answers a choice question with No and uses expensive, which looks like expense.
full/#f8/p2/#fm8-p2-10/qko: 젠슨 씨가 왜 고객과의 점심 약속을 목요일로 옮겼나요?

(A) is correct: instead of giving the reason directly, it asks back "Didn't you see her e-mail?", meaning the reason was in the e-mail. (B) names the lunch place, and (C) is an association trap that repeats lunch and talks about a lunch menu.
full/#f8/p2/#fm8-p2-11/qko: 신입 사원들은 각자 팀과 함께 앉아야 할까요, 한곳에 모여 앉아야 할까요?
Should the new hires sit with their teams or together in one area?

Are you going to the company's anniversary party tonight?

Asked whether they're going to tonight's party, (B) is correct: it answers Yes and adds "I'll see you there." (A) is a trap that repeats party and uses the past tense as if it were already over, and (C) is a trap that uses party in a different sense, a group of diners at a restaurant.
full/#f8/p2/#fm8-p2-15/qko: 에브너 씨가 휴가 중인 동안 그분 업무는 누가 맡나요?
Who's taking over Ms. Ebner's duties while she's on leave?

full/#f8/p2/#fm8-p2-15/exp: 업무를 누가 대신 맡을지 묻자 아직 정하는 중이라며 미정이라고 돌려 답한 (C)가 정답이다. (A)는 명사 leave(휴가)를 동사 leave(떠나다)로 바꿔 퇴근 시간을 말한 함정이고, (B)는 duties를 반복해 업무 내용을 설명했을 뿐 담당자를 말하지 않았다.

Asked who will take over her duties, (C) is correct: it indirectly says it hasn't been decided yet. (A) is a trap that turns the noun leave (time off) into the verb leave (to go) and gives a departure time, and (B) repeats duties and describes them without naming who will cover them.
full/#f8/p2/#fm8-p2-16/qko: 돌아오는 길에 프랑크푸르트에서 환승 대기 시간이 얼마나 돼요?

The correct answer responds to the How long question about the layover with a length of time: a little over three hours. 'At Gate 22, I think.' is a place you might associate with an airport (an answer to Where), and 'I've been there twice.' says how many times the speaker has been to Frankfurt.
full/#f8/p2/#fm8-p2-17/qko: 자선 만찬에 참석을 확정한 손님은 몇 명인가요?

full/#f8/p2/#fm8-p2-19/qko: 주최 측은 우리 발표 슬라이드를 언제까지 받아야 하나요?

(B) is a trap that uses organized, similar to organizers, to comment on a past event, and (A) repeats presentation and gives a topic, answering What.

Asked to confirm whether they stayed at that hotel last time, the correct answer says Yes and adds that it was very comfortable. full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-12/qko: Do you know when the new product line launches?
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-12/ok/2: I heard it's in early March.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-12/exp: 간접 의문문의 핵심은 when 이므로 출시 시기(early March)를 알려 준 (C)가 정답이다. (A)는 launch 와 소리가 비슷한 lunch 를 쓴 함정이고, (B)는 line 을 '줄'이라는 뜻으로 반복한 오답이다.

The key word in this indirect question is when, so (C), which gives the launch time (early March), is correct. (A) is a trap using lunch, which sounds like launch, and (B) repeats line with the meaning "a queue."
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-13/qko: 복사실 천장에서 물이 새던 곳은 수리됐나요?
Has the leak in the copy room ceiling been repaired?
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-13/ok/1: 배관공이 내일 다시 와서 마무리할 거예요.
The plumber's coming back tomorrow to finish.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-13/exp: 수리가 끝났는지 묻는 질문에 '배관공이 내일 다시 와서 마무리한다', 즉 아직 다 끝나지 않았다고 돌려 답한 것이 정답이다. 'I'll make twenty copies.'는 copy room의 copy를 반복한 함정이고, 'The ceiling fans are new.'는 ceiling을 반복했을 뿐 누수 수리와 관계없다.

Asked whether the repair is finished, the correct answer indirectly says it isn't done yet: the plumber is coming back tomorrow to finish. 'I'll make twenty copies.' is a trap that repeats copy from copy room, and 'The ceiling fans are new.' only repeats ceiling and has nothing to do with the leak repair.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-14/qko: Where are we meeting the clients after we land?
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-14/ok/1: At the coffee shop in the arrivals hall.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-14/ok/2: They've been our clients for years.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-14/exp: 만날 장소를 묻는 Where 질문에 '도착 홀의 커피숍'이라는 장소로 답한 것이 정답이다. 'Around three in the afternoon.'은 시각(When에 대한 답)이고, 'They've been our clients for years.'는 clients를 반복했을 뿐 장소를 말하지 않는다.

The correct answer replies to the Where question with a place: the coffee shop in the arrivals hall. 'Around three in the afternoon.' gives a time (an answer to When), and 'They've been our clients for years.' only repeats clients and doesn't give a place.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-15/qko: What's the price of the large gift basket?
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-15/ok/0: It comes with a greeting card.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-15/ok/2: In the basket by the door.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-15/exp: 가격을 묻는 질문에 금액(Forty-five dollars)으로 답한 (B)가 정답이다. (A)는 선물 바구니 구성품을 말할 뿐 가격이 없고, (C)는 basket 을 반복한 장소 응답이다.
Asked about the price, (B) is correct because it gives an amount (Forty-five dollars). (A) only says what comes with the gift basket, not the price, and (C) repeats basket and gives a location.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-16/qko: Why did Ms. Dawson turn down the promotion?
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-16/ok/1: She'd have to relocate to Phoenix.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-16/ok/2: Turn it down a little, please.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-16/exp: 승진을 거절한 이유를 묻자 승진하면 피닉스로 이주해야 한다고 이유를 말한 (B)가 정답이다. (A)는 promotion과 형태가 비슷한 promotional(판촉의)을 이용한 함정이고, (C)는 turn down을 '(소리를) 줄이다'라는 다른 뜻으로 반복한 오답이다.

Asked why she turned down the promotion, (B) is correct: it gives the reason, that she would have to move to Phoenix. (A) is a trap using promotional (related to sales promotion), which looks like promotion, and (C) repeats turn down with a different meaning, "to lower (the volume)."
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-17/qko: Mr. Cardenas is retiring at the end of the year, isn't he?
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-17/ok/1: At the end of the hall.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-17/exp: 연말에 은퇴하는지 확인하자 사실은 시간제로 계속 일할 것이라며 '완전히 은퇴하는 것은 아니다'라고 바로잡은 (C)가 정답이다. (A)는 retiring과 발음이 비슷한 tiring을 이용한 함정이고, (B)는 the end of를 반복해 위치를 말한 오답이다.

Asked to confirm that he's retiring at the end of the year, (C) is correct: it corrects the speaker, saying he'll actually keep working part-time, so he isn't fully retiring. (A) is a trap using tiring, which sounds like retiring, and (B) repeats the end of and gives a location.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-18/qko: Is the plumber coming today or tomorrow?
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-18/ok/1: He fixed the sink last year.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-18/exp: 오늘과 내일 중 언제 오는지 묻는 질문에 둘 다 고르지 않고 '사실 이미 와 있다'고 답한 것이 정답이다. 'He fixed the sink last year.'는 plumber에서 연상되는 싱크대 수리를 과거 시제로 말한 함정이고, 'Tomorrow's forecast is sunny.'는 tomorrow를 반복했을 뿐 배관공의 방문과 무관하다.

Asked whether the plumber is coming today or tomorrow, the correct answer picks neither: he's already here, actually. 'He fixed the sink last year.' is a trap about fixing a sink, associated with plumber, in the past tense, and 'Tomorrow's forecast is sunny.' only repeats tomorrow and has nothing to do with the plumber's visit.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-19/qko: When does the trade show in Phoenix open?
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-19/ok/0: On the fourteenth of next month.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-19/ok/2: Yes, it was a great show.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-19/exp: When 으로 개막 시점을 묻자 '다음 달 14일'이라는 날짜로 답한 (A)가 정답이다. (B)는 Where 질문에 어울리는 장소 응답이고, (C)는 의문사 의문문에 Yes 로 답하면서 show 를 반복하고 시제까지 과거로 바꾼 함정이다.

Asked with When about the opening, (A) is correct because it gives a date: the fourteenth of next month. (B) is a place, which fits a Where question, and (C) is a trap that answers a wh-question with Yes, repeats show, and even switches to the past tense.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-20/qko: 기록 보관실의 서류 정리 체계는 누가 만들었나요?
Who set up the filing system in the records room?
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-20/ok/1: It was already here when I started.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-20/ok/2: The room's on the second floor.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-20/exp: 누가 체계를 만들었는지 묻자 자신이 입사했을 때 이미 있었다며 '누가 만들었는지 모른다'는 뜻을 돌려 말한 (B)가 정답이다. (A)는 filing system에서 연상되는 정리 방식을 말한 How 응답이고, (C)는 room을 반복해 위치를 말한 Where 응답이다.

Asked who set up the system, (B) is correct: by saying it was already there when they started, the speaker indirectly means "I don't know who did it." (A) is a How response describing a way of organizing files, associated with filing system, and (C) repeats room and gives a location, a Where response.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-21/qko: 리마 학회에 가려면 비자는 언제 신청해야 하나요?
When should I apply for a visa for the Lima conference?
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-21/ok/0: At the consulate on Hill Street.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-21/ok/1: 그렇게 짧게 머무르면 비자가 필요 없을 거예요.
You won't need one for a stay that short.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-21/ok/2: I applied for that position last year.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-21/exp: 비자 신청 시점을 묻는 질문에 '그 정도로 짧은 체류에는 비자가 필요 없다'고 질문의 전제를 바로잡은 우회 응답이 정답이다. 'At the consulate on Hill Street.'는 신청 장소(Where에 대한 답)이고, 'I applied for that position last year.'는 apply를 반복했지만 일자리에 지원한 이야기라 질문과 무관하다.

Asked when to apply for a visa, the correct answer is an indirect response that corrects the question's assumption: you won't need a visa for such a short stay. 'At the consulate on Hill Street.' gives a place to apply (an answer to Where), and 'I applied for that position last year.' repeats apply but is about applying for a job, so it's unrelated.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-22/qko: 애벗 씨가 방금 우리 채용 제안을 수락했어요.
Ms. Abbott just accepted our job offer.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-22/exp: 애벗 씨가 채용 제안을 수락했다는 소식에 반가워하며 출근일을 되묻는 (B)가 정답이다. (A)는 offer를 '할인 혜택'이라는 다른 뜻으로 반복한 함정이고, (C)는 job을 반복한 오답이다.

Hearing that Ms. Abbott accepted the job offer, (B) is correct: it reacts happily and asks when she starts. (A) is a trap that repeats offer with a different meaning, "a deal or discount," and (C) just repeats job.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-23/qko: 교육 자료를 인쇄해 드릴까요, 사내망에 올려 드릴까요?
Do you want the training materials printed or uploaded to the intranet?
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-23/ok/0: 로비에 걸린 판화들은 새로 들여온 거예요.
The prints in the lobby are new.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-23/ok/1: 올리는 게 종이를 아낄 수 있겠네요.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-23/exp: 인쇄와 사내망 업로드 중 무엇을 원하는지 묻자 업로드하면 종이를 아낄 수 있다며 업로드를 고른 (B)가 정답이다. (A)는 printed와 형태가 비슷한 prints(판화)를 이용해 로비 장식 이야기를 한 함정이고, (C)는 training을 반복해 교육 결과를 말한 오답이다.

Asked whether the materials should be printed or uploaded to the intranet, (B) is correct: it chooses uploading because it would save paper. (A) is a trap that uses prints (artwork prints), which looks like printed, to talk about decorations in the lobby, and (C) repeats training and talks about how the training went.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-24/qko: 50달러 이상 주문에 아직도 무료 배송을 해 주나요?
Are we still offering free delivery on orders over fifty dollars?
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-24/ok/2: Only until the end of this month.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-24/exp: 무료 배송을 아직 하는지 묻자 Yes 를 생략하고 '이번 달 말까지만'이라고 조건을 붙여 답한 (C)가 정답이다. (A)는 fifty 를 반복한 수량 응답이고, (B)는 delivery 와 비슷한 delivered 를 쓴 특정 배달 이야기일 뿐 정책에 대한 답이 아니다.

Asked whether free delivery is still offered, (C) is correct: it skips the Yes and adds a condition, "Only until the end of this month." (A) repeats fifty and gives a quantity, and (B) uses delivered, similar to delivery, but only talks about one delivery, not the policy.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-25/qko: 고객 한 분이 계산대에 우산을 두고 갔어요.
A customer left her umbrella at the checkout counter.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-25/ok/0: I'll put it in the lost-and-found box.
full/#f9/p2/#fm9-p2-25/exp: 고객이 두고 간 우산에 대해 '분실물 상자에 넣어 두겠다'고 적절한 조치를 말한 (A)가 정답이다. (B)는 checkout 과 비슷한 check out 을 쓴 함정이고, (C)는 counter 와 소리가 비슷한 counted 를 쓴 오답이다.

Told that a customer left her umbrella, (A) is correct: it gives a suitable action, putting it in the lost-and-found box. (B) is a trap using check out, similar to checkout, and (C) uses counted, which sounds like counter.
full/#f9/p3/#fm9-p3-01/lines/0/ko: 나이절, 근무 시작 전에 새 모바일 키 시스템에 대해 짚고 넘어가고 싶어요. 월요일부터 시행되거든요.
Nigel, before your shift starts, I want to go over the new mobile key system. It launches on Monday.
full/#f9/p3/#fm9-p3-01/lines/1/ko: 투숙객이 휴대폰으로 객실 문을 여는 그 시스템 말씀이세요?
Is that the one where guests can unlock their doors with their phones?
full/#f9/p3/#fm9-p3-01/lines/2/ko: 맞아요. 투숙객이 우리 앱을 내려받아 온라인으로 체크인하면 디지털 키가 휴대폰으로 전송돼서, 프런트 데스크에 들를 필요가 전혀 없어요.
That's right. Once guests download our app and check in online, a digital key is sent to their phone, so they don't need to stop by the front desk at all.
full/#f9/p3/#fm9-p3-01/lines/3/ko: 로비 대기 줄이 줄어들겠네요. 그런데 투숙객 휴대폰 배터리가 다 되면 어떻게 하죠?
That should shorten the lines in the lobby. But what if a guest's phone battery runs out?
full/#f9/p3/#fm9-p3-01/lines/4/ko: 좋은 질문이에요. 그럴 때는 전처럼 프런트에 와서 일반 카드 키를 받으면 돼요.
Good question. They can still come to the desk and get a regular key card, just like before.
full/#f9/p3/#fm9-p3-01/lines/5/ko: 알겠어요. 그리고 앱에 대한 교육도 받게 되나요?
OK. And will we be getting any training on the app?
full/#f9/p3/#fm9-p3-01/lines/6/ko: 네, 소프트웨어 회사 담당자가 금요일 2시에 와서 모두에게 사용법을 보여 줄 거예요. 그날 오전 근무시니까 조금 더 남아서 참석해 줄 수 있어요?
Yes, a representative from the software company is coming at two on Friday to show everyone how it works. Since you're on the morning shift that day, could you stay a little later to attend?
full/#f9/p3/#fm9-p3-01/qs/0/qko: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
full/#f9/p3/#fm9-p3-01/qs/0/exp: 여자가 'the new mobile key system'을 설명하고, 투숙객이 휴대폰으로 객실 문을 여는 방식이라는 내용이 이어진다. mobile key system(모바일 키 시스템) → a new way for guests to enter their rooms(투숙객이 객실에 들어가는 새 방법). 휴대폰 배터리 문제는 가정해서 물어본 것일 뿐 실제 투숙객의 문제가 아니다.

The woman explains 'the new mobile key system,' and the conversation goes on to describe how guests will unlock their rooms with their phones. mobile key system → a new way for guests to enter their rooms. The dead phone battery is only a hypothetical question, not a real guest's problem.
full/#f9/p3/#fm9-p3-01/qs/1/qko: 여자에 따르면 투숙객은 휴대폰이 작동하지 않으면 무엇을 할 수 있는가?
According to the woman, what can guests do if their phone stops working?
full/#f9/p3/#fm9-p3-01/qs/1/exp: 휴대폰 배터리가 다 되면 어떻게 하느냐는 질문에 여자는 'They can still come to the desk and get a regular key card'라고 답한다. come to the desk and get a regular key card → pick up a key card at the front desk. 직원 호출, 앱 재설치, 로비에서 충전하기는 언급되지 않았다.

Asked what happens if a phone battery runs out, the woman says, 'They can still come to the desk and get a regular key card.' come to the desk and get a regular key card → pick up a key card at the front desk. Calling a staff member, reinstalling the app, and charging in the lobby are not mentioned.
full/#f9/p3/#fm9-p3-01/qs/2/qko: What does the woman ask the man to do?
full/#f9/p3/#fm9-p3-01/qs/2/exp: 여자는 금요일 2시에 소프트웨어 회사 담당자가 사용법을 보여 준다고 하면서 'could you stay a little later to attend?'라고 부탁한다. 즉 교육에 참석해 달라는 것이다. 월요일은 시스템 시행일이고, 소프트웨어 회사 담당자는 회사 쪽에서 오는 것이므로 남자가 연락할 필요가 없다.

The woman says a representative from the software company will show everyone how it works at two on Friday and asks, 'could you stay a little later to attend?' In other words, she wants him to attend the training. Monday is when the system launches, and the software company's representative is coming to them, so the man doesn't need to contact anyone.
full/#f9/p3/#fm9-p3-02/lines/0/ko: 안녕하세요, 그레타. 새 노트북이 준비됐다는 이메일을 받았어요. 지금 가져가도 될까요?
Hi, Greta, I got an e-mail saying my new laptop is ready. Can I pick it up now?
full/#f9/p3/#fm9-p3-02/lines/1/ko: 네, 곤살로, 바로 여기 있어요. 그런데 데이터를 지울 수 있게 예전 노트북도 주셔야 해요.
Yes, Gonzalo, it's right here. But I'll also need your old laptop so we can erase the data on it.
full/#f9/p3/#fm9-p3-02/lines/2/ko: 아, 그건 책상에 두고 왔어요. 그리고 아직 그 안에 필요한 파일이 좀 있어요.
Oh, I left it at my desk. And there are still some files on it that I need.
full/#f9/p3/#fm9-p3-02/lines/3/ko: 괜찮아요. 그 파일들을 공유 드라이브에 저장했어요?
That's OK. Have you saved them to the shared drive?
full/#f9/p3/#fm9-p3-02/lines/4/ko: 아직이요. 몇 개는 용량이 큰 디자인 파일이라 공간이 충분할지 잘 모르겠어서요.
Not yet. Some of them are large design files, and I wasn't sure there'd be enough space.
full/#f9/p3/#fm9-p3-02/lines/5/ko: 직원마다 공유 드라이브에 200기가바이트씩 주어지니까 문제없을 거예요. 오늘 전부 복사해 두고 내일 아침에 예전 노트북을 갖다주세요.
Every employee gets two hundred gigabytes on the shared drive, so that won't be a problem. Just copy everything over today and bring me the old laptop tomorrow morning.
full/#f9/p3/#fm9-p3-02/lines/6/ko: 그럴게요. 새 노트북은 지금 가져가면 되나요?
Will do. Should I take the new one with me now?
full/#f9/p3/#fm9-p3-02/lines/7/ko: 네, 가져가세요. 쓰시는 프로그램은 제가 이미 다 설치해 놨으니까 바로 작업을 시작하셔도 돼요.
Yes, go ahead. I've already installed all the programs you use, so you can start working on it right away.
full/#f9/p3/#fm9-p3-02/qs/0/qko: Why did the man come to see the woman?
full/#f9/p3/#fm9-p3-02/qs/0/exp: 남자가 새 노트북이 준비됐다는 이메일을 받고 'Can I pick it up now?'라고 묻는다. new laptop → new computer. 예전 노트북을 돌려줘야 하긴 하지만 책상에 두고 와서 내일 아침에 가져오기로 했으므로 장비 반납은 이번 방문의 목적이 아니다.
